title.en: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
title.zh: 特朗普称立即禁止CNN和Politico进入白宫

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has announced an immediate ban on CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from the White House, citing their reporting as "fiction or lies." CNN has called the move an "illegal assault" on press freedoms, and legal challenges are expected.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布立即禁止CNN、MS NOW和Politico进入白宫，理由是它们的报道是“虚构或谎言”。CNN称此举是对新闻自由的“非法攻击”，预计将面临法律挑战。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has announced that he is "immediately" banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, the latest twist in his fraught relationship with media outlets.

In a post on Truth Social on Friday, Trump said that the outlets "constantly write or report fiction or lies" about his administration, although he provided no examples.

Trump later called it a "very simple ban", but did not explain how it would work. It is unclear whether employees of those outlets would be prevented from entering the White House grounds.

CNN swiftly slammed the move as an "illegal assault" on American press freedoms. The move by Trump is likely to be met with legal challenges.

Reporters from both Politico and CNN were still on the White House grounds shortly after the announcement was made.

A crew from CNN was also travelling with Vice-President JD Vance to and from an event in Iowa.

In a statement, the network called a potential ban illegal and said it "stands fully behind our White House team and their fair and accurate reporting."

"We have a right under the US Constitution to do that reporting without hindrance or interference from the government," the CNN statement said. "Should the ban which President Trump threatened go ahead, it would be an illegal assault on that fundamental and constitutionally-protected right."

Politico also released a statement, saying it "will continue to fairly report on this White House and future ones.

"We will vigorously defend our First Amendment rights against any attempt to restrict them."

In his post Trump said: "Media outlets shouldn't be able to constantly write or report fiction and lies when they're covering the President of the United States, the Trump Administration or the United States of America. Other news outlets to follow."

Asked about the ban in the Oval Office, Trump said that there was "no reason" for the announcement being made on Friday afternoon.

"It's really just cumulative stories over the last few years," he said. "You get sick of it."

Trump added that there "may be others to join them", but did not name any specific news outlets.

He also acknowledged that legal challenges may follow his announcement, saying "I think it's good to point it out, whether it survives or doesn't".

Since returning to office in January 2025, Trump and administration officials have repeatedly clashed with members of the White House press corps. In his second term, Trump has also moved to bring conservative bloggers, influencers and other media into the press room, arguing it is necessary to provide diverse perspectives to the American public.

In February, the White House announced that it was taking control of the press pool which has access to Trump and had for more than a century been managed by the...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布，他“立即”禁止 CNN、MS NOW 和 Politico 进入白宫，这是他与媒体机构之间紧张关系的最新转折。 特朗普周五在《Truth Social》上发表的一篇文章中表示，这些媒体“不断撰写或报道有关他的政府的虚构或谎言”，尽管他没有提供任何例子。 特朗普后来称其为“非常简单的禁令”，但没有解释它将如何运作。目前尚不清楚这些机构的员工是否会被禁止进入白宫。 美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）迅速抨击此举是对美国新闻自由的“非法侵犯”。特朗普的举动可能会遇到法律挑战。 消息公布后不久，Politico 和 CNN 的记者仍在白宫。 CNN 的一名工作人员还与副总统 JD 万斯一起往返于爱荷华州的一个活动。 该网络在一份声明中称潜在的禁令是非法的，并表示“完全支持我们的白宫团队及其公平准确的报道”。 美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的声明称：“根据美国宪法，我们有权在不受政府阻碍或干涉的情况下进行报道。” “如果特朗普总统威胁实施的禁令继续下去，这将是对这项受宪法保护的基本权利的非法侵犯。” Politico 还发表声明，称其“将继续公正地报道本届白宫和未来的白宫”。 “我们将大力捍卫我们的第一修正案权利，反对任何限制这些权利的企图。” 特朗普在帖子中表示：“媒体在报道美国总统、特朗普政府或美利坚合众国时，不应该不断地撰写或报道虚构和谎言。其他新闻媒体将跟进。” 当被问及椭圆形办公室的禁令时，特朗普表示，周五下午宣布这一消息“没有理由”。 “这实际上只是过去几年累积的故事，”他说。 “你会厌倦的。” 特朗普补充说，“可能还有其他人加入他们的行列”，但没有透露任何具体新闻媒体的名字。 他还承认，他的声明可能会带来法律挑战，并表示“我认为指出这一点是件好事，无论它是否存在”。 自2025年1月重返办公室以来，特朗普和政府官员多次与白宫记者团成员发生冲突。在第二任期内，特朗普还采取行动，将保守派博主、有影响力的人士和其他媒体带入新闻发布室，认为有必要向美国公众提供多样化的观点。 今年二月，白宫宣布将控制新闻媒体库，该媒体库可以接触到特朗普，并且一个多世纪以来一直由...

reflection.en: In a world saturated with information, the temptation to label opposing viewpoints as 'lies' or 'fiction' is strong. Ephesians 4:25 reminds us to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another." This call to honesty is vital, especially when disagreements arise, urging us to engage with truth even when it's difficult.
reflection.zh: 在一个信息泛滥的世界里，将对立的观点标记为“虚构”或“谎言”的诱惑很强烈。《以弗所书》4:25提醒我们“要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话”。这种对诚实的呼吁至关重要，尤其是在出现分歧时，它敦促我们在困难时也要坚持说实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Donald Trump's 'Illegal assault' on press freedom
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的“非法攻击”新闻自由

summary.en: The US President has announced that he is banning several major news outlets from the White House.
summary.zh: 美国总统宣布禁止几家主要新闻媒体进入白宫。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump said Saturday morning he was banning news outlets CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, accusing them without specifics of reporting "fiction and lies."

Trump added that "other Fake News Media Outlets" would face a similar fate, but did not say which ones.

The move drew immediate accusations that it was unconstitutional and would be thrown out by the courts.

"I am proud to announce that, effective immediately, I am banning Fake News CNN, MSNOW... and Politico... from the White House as a result of their constant 'reporting' FAKE NEWS!" Trump said on his Truth Social platform.

Trump did not say what had prompted the move but added that "media Outlets shouldn't be able to constantly write or report FICTION and LIES when they're covering the President of the United States, the Trump Administration, or the United States of America."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Later in the Oval Office, Trump told reporters: "I think that somebody has a right to keep them away if they're going to write false stories all the time."

"You get sick of it," he said. "They're smart people, but they purposely write negative news, and they do that because they want to try and diminish the Republicans and a Republican administration."

CNN said Saturday that President Donald Trump's plan to ban the TV network and two other news outlets from the White House was an "illegal assault" on US press freedom.

The network said its reporting was "fair and accurate" and was protected under the US Constitution, adding a ban "would be an illegal assault on that fundamental and constitutionally-protected right."

It is extremely rare for US presidents to outright bar news outlets from the White House, although Trump banned a CNN reporter in his first term and Richard Nixon put restrictions on The Washington Post over its reporting on the Watergate scandal.

But in his second term, Trump's administration has put stricter controls on reporters, including taking control of which journalists can cover events as part of the "pool" admitted to tight spaces such as the Oval Office and Air Force One.

Last year, Trump barred The Associated Press from some events because of the news agency's decision to continue referring to the "Gulf of Mexico" — and not the "Gulf of America" as decreed by Trump.

For the time being, reporters for Politico and CNN were still in the White House press room following Trump's announcement.

Both of the 80-year-old president's White House terms have seen him lash out repeatedly at media whose coverage displeases him.

Trump has filed multiple defamation suits against news outlets, attacked the press on Truth Social...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周六上午表示，他将禁止新闻媒体 CNN、MS NOW 和 Politico 进入白宫，指责它们报道“虚构和谎言”，但没有具体说明。 特朗普补充说，“其他假新闻媒体”也将面临类似的命运，但没有透露是哪些。 此举立即遭到指责，称其违宪，将被法院驳回。 “我很自豪地宣布，我将立即禁止假新闻 CNN、MSNOW...和 ​​Politico...进入白宫，因为他们不断‘报道’假新闻！”特朗普在他的“真相社交”平台上说道。 特朗普没有透露是什么促使了这一举动，但补充说，“媒体在报道美国总统、特朗普政府或美利坚合众国时，不应该不断地撰写或报道虚构和谎言。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 随后，特朗普在椭圆形办公室对记者表示：“我认为，如果他们一直在写虚假故事，那么有人有权将他们拒之门外。” “你会厌倦它，”他说。 “他们是聪明人，但他们故意写负面新闻，他们这样做是因为他们想试图削弱共和党人和共和党政府。” 美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 周六表示，唐纳德·特朗普总统禁止该电视网络和另外两家新闻媒体进入白宫的计划是对美国新闻自由的“非法侵犯”。 该网络表示，其报​​道“公平、准确”，并受到美国宪法的保护，并补充说，禁令“将是对这一受宪法保护的基本权利的非法侵犯”。 美国总统彻底禁止新闻媒体进入白宫的情况极为罕见，尽管特朗普在第一个任期内禁止了 CNN 记者，理查德·尼克松也对《华盛顿邮报》对水门丑闻的报道进行了限制。 但在特朗普的第二个任期内，特朗普政府对记者实施了更严格的控制，包括控制哪些记者可以报道事件，作为进入椭圆形办公室和空军一号等狭小空间的“池”的一部分。 去年，特朗普禁止美联社参加一些活动，因为该通讯社决定继续提及“墨西哥湾”，而不是特朗普颁布的“美国湾”。 特朗普宣布这一消息后，Politico 和 CNN 的记者暂时仍在白宫新闻发布室。 这位80岁的总统在两届白宫任期内都多次猛烈抨击那些报道令他不满的媒体。 特朗普对新闻媒体提起多起诽谤诉讼，在《真相社会》上攻击媒体……

reflection.en: In the pursuit of truth, it is vital to hear all perspectives. Banning news outlets from the White House, as President Trump has done with CNN, MSNOW, and Politico, risks silencing voices and preventing a full understanding of events. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that 'The first to speak in a dispute sounds convincing, until someone else questions them.' A...
reflection.zh: 在追求真理的过程中，倾听所有观点至关重要。正如特朗普总统对CNN、MSNOW和Politico所做的那样，禁止新闻媒体进入白宫，可能会压制不同的声音，阻碍对事件的全面理解。《箴言》18:17提醒我们：“先说话的似乎有理，直到别人来辩论，就显出破绽。”健康的民主需要开放的对话和自由的信息交流，即使这些信息是批评性的。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Louisiana woman faces charges after 17 cats found dead in extreme-heat conditions
title.zh: 路易斯安那州女子因17只猫在极端高温下死亡面临指控

summary.en: A 29-year-old Louisiana woman, Madison Rebecca Colello, has surrendered to authorities and faces multiple animal cruelty charges after 17 cats were found dead at a local business. The animals were discovered in extreme heat without adequate food or water, and 20 other cats in severe distress were rescued.
summary.zh: 一名29岁的路易斯安那州女子Madison Rebecca Colello在当地一家企业内发现17只猫死亡后，已向当局自首，并面临多项虐待动物的指控。这些动物在极端高温下被发现，且缺乏足够的食物和水，另有20只猫处于严重痛苦中被救出。

body.en: Madison Rebecca Colello, 29, surrenders after 20 other cats in severe distress rescued from business in town of Walker A Louisiana woman faces dozens of animal cruelty charges after 17 cats were found dead at a local business amid dangerously hot conditions without food or water, with 20 other cats in severe distress being rescued. Madison Rebecca Colello, 29, surrendered on Thursday morning at the Livingston parish detention center in Walker, Louisiana. She faces 17 felony counts of aggravated animal cruelty – in connection with the dead cats – and 37 misdemeanor counts of animal cruelty. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的麦迪逊·丽贝卡·科莱洛 (Madison Rebecca Colello) 在沃克 (Walker) 镇的一家企业中救出了另外 20 只处于严重困境的猫后投降 一名路易斯安那州妇女面临数十项虐待动物指控，因为当地一家企业的 17 只猫被发现在危险的炎热条件下死亡，没有食物和水，另外 20 只处于严重困境的猫被救出。 29 岁的麦迪逊·丽贝卡·科莱洛 (Madison Rebecca Colello) 周四上午在路易斯安那州沃克市利文斯顿教区拘留中心自首。她面临 17 项与死猫有关的严重虐待动物重罪和 37 项虐待动物轻罪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of 17 dead cats in Walker, Louisiana, amid dangerously hot conditions points to a profound failure of care and responsibility. The charges against Madison Rebecca Colello underscore the need for justice and compassion, reminding us of the call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God.
reflection.zh: 在路易斯安那州沃克镇，发现17只猫在危险的高温下死亡，这暴露了照管和责任的严重缺失。对Madison Rebecca Colello的指控，凸显了对公正和怜悯的需求，提醒我们当行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Watch: Trump says ban on some news outlets is 'because they're fake news'
title.zh: 特朗普称禁止一些新闻机构是因为它们是“假新闻”

summary.en: The US president announced on Friday that he is "immediately" banning CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from the White House, citing them as "fake news" and "dishonest."
summary.zh: 美国总统周五宣布，他将“立即”禁止CNN、MS NOW和Politico进入白宫，并指责它们是“假新闻”和“不诚实”。

body.en:
The US president on Friday announced he is "immediately" banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House.

During an Oval Office event, he accused the three outlets of being "fake news" and "dishonest".

It is unclear what exactly a ban would entail, and whether employees of those outlets would be prevented from entering the White House grounds.
body.zh: 美国总统周五宣布，他“立即”禁止 CNN、MS NOW 和 Politico 进入白宫。 在椭圆形办公室的一次活动中，他指责这三个媒体是“假新闻”和“不诚实”。 目前尚不清楚禁令具体意味着什么，以及是否会阻止这些机构的员工进入白宫。

reflection.en: When leaders label news outlets as "fake news," it raises questions about truth and accountability in public discourse. The Bible calls us to speak truthfully, as Ephesians 4:25 urges, "Therefore, each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor, for we are all members of one body."
reflection.zh: 当领导人将新闻机构标记为“假新闻”时，这会引发关于公共话语中真理和问责制的问题。《以弗所书》4:25 劝勉我们：“所以，你们各人要弃绝谎言，各人要跟邻舍说诚实话，因为我们是互相联络的一体。”

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: 'Temper tantrum': Why European countries are moving gold out of the US
title.zh: ‘脾气发作’：欧洲国家为何要将黄金运出美国

summary.en: Amid ongoing geopolitical unrest, some European nations are relocating tonnes of gold from storage facilities in the United States. This month, the Netherlands announced the transfer of 86 tonnes of gold from vaults in the US and Canada to the Bank of England in London.
summary.zh: 在持续的地缘政治动荡中，一些欧洲国家正在将储存在美国的数吨黄金转移。本月，荷兰宣布已将其86吨黄金从美国和加拿大的金库转移到伦敦的英格兰银行。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Gold signage stands outside the Oval Office, gilded ornaments sit on its fireplace, and walls and ceilings now feature gold embellishments.

But while Trump may see gold as a visual shorthand for wealth and success, recent moves by France and the Netherlands to shift their gold reserves out of the United States may signal the exact opposite.

This month, the Netherlands announced it had transferred 86 tonnes of gold — equivalent to almost 7,000 bars — from vaults in the US and Canada to the Bank of England in London.

Although the transfer of around 59 tonnes of this was achieved by trading gold in New York for gold in London, more than 27 tonnes were physically moved.

The De Nederlandsche Bank said it was motivated by "increasing geopolitical unrest".

"Keeping a larger share of the gold reserves in London strengthens the function of gold as an anchor of trust," the bank said in a statement on 2 September.

The move follows France's announcement earlier this year that it had also shifted 129 tonnes of its gold from New York.

Some countries have been buying more gold in recent years, driving up the volume held by central banks. Between 2018 and 2025, reserves increased by 8.5 per cent.

During the same period, the price of gold has skyrocketed , increasing the market value of these reserves by 268 per cent, according to the International Monetary Fund.

Some experts say the moves could reflect concerns about the stability of institutions the world has relied on for decades.

A country generally holds gold as part of its reserve assets, which act as a financial safety net. Reserves can help maintain the value of currency, protect against financial crises, and ensure countries can pay for imports and meet international debt repayments.

Australia's central bank, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA), holds 80 tonnes of gold as part of its reserve assets, alongside government bonds from other countries.

While Australia's gold reserves have largely remained unchanged since 1997, there's been a shift among other central banks such as China, India, Poland and Türkiye, which have started to favour buying gold over US government bonds.

Poland has significantly increased its gold reserves over the last 20 years, building it up from just 14 tonnes in 1996 to more than 630 tonnes by mid-2026.

Scott French, a senior lecturer at the University of NSW's school of economics, says gold is a commodity with intrinsic value that tends to increase over time.

This makes it a safe asset that generally doesn't lose its...
body.zh: 分享您的反馈并帮助我们改进此功能。请在此处详细了解我们如何在 SBS 使用人工智能。 金色标牌矗立在椭圆形办公室外，镀金装饰品放在壁炉上，墙壁和天花板现在也有金色装饰。 不过，尽管特朗普可能将黄金视为财富和成功的视觉象征，但法国和荷兰最近将黄金储备转移出美国的举措可能发出完全相反的信号。 本月，荷兰宣布已将 86 吨黄金（相当于近 7,000 根金条）从美国和加拿大的金库转移到伦敦的英格兰银行。 尽管其中约 59 吨的转移是通过在纽约进行黄金与伦敦黄金的交易实现的，但仍有超过 27 吨是实际转移的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 荷兰银行表示，此举的动机是“地缘政治动荡加剧”。 该银行在 9 月 2 日的一份声明中表示，“在伦敦保留更大份额的黄金储备，加强了黄金作为信任之锚的功能。” 此前，法国今年早些时候宣布也从纽约转移了 129 吨黄金。 近年来，一些国家一直在购买更多的黄金，从而增加了央行持有的黄金数量。 2018年至2025年间，储备增加了8.5%。 根据国际货币基金组织的数据，同期黄金价格飙升，使这些储备的市场价值增加了​​ 268%。 一些专家表示，这些举措可能反映出人们对世界数十年来所依赖的机构稳定性的担忧。 一个国家通常持有黄金作为其储备资产的一部分，充当金融安全网。储备可以帮助维持货币价值，防范金融危机，并确保各国能够支付进口费用并偿还国际债务。 澳大利亚中央银行澳大利亚储备银行 (RBA) 持有 80 吨黄金作为其储备资产的一部分，此外还持有其他国家的政府债券。 尽管澳大利亚的黄金储备自 1997 年以来基本保持不变，但中国、印度、波兰和土耳其等其他央行却发生了转变，它们开始倾向于购买黄金而不是美国政府债券。 过去 20 年来，波兰的黄金储备大幅增加，从 1996 年的仅为 14 吨增加到 2026 年中期的 630 吨以上。 新南威尔士大学经济学院高级讲师斯科特·弗伦奇表示，黄金是一种具有内在价值的商品，其内在价值往往会随着时间的推移而增加。 这使其成为一种安全资产，通常不会失去其...

reflection.en: As geopolitical tensions rise, nations are moving their gold reserves, seeking security in uncertain times. This act reflects a deep human desire for peace and an end to conflict. The ancient words of Psalm 46:9 offer a profound hope: that ultimately, it is Yahweh who brings an end to all wars, establishing peace across the earth.
reflection.zh: 随着地缘政治紧张局势的加剧，各国正在转移其黄金储备，在不确定的时期寻求安全。这一举动反映了人类对和平和结束冲突的深切渴望。诗篇46:9古老的言语提供了一个深刻的希望：最终，是雅伟结束一切争战，在全地上建立和平。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
title.zh: 载有爆炸物的车辆撞入巴基斯坦清真寺，至少17人死亡

summary.en: At least 17 people were killed and 73 injured when a vehicle packed with explosives rammed into a mosque in Kohat, Pakistan. Among the dead were seven police officers and a four-year-old child. Gunmen also attacked a nearby police facility.
summary.zh: 据巴基斯坦新闻社报道，一辆装满爆炸物的车辆在巴基斯坦西北部城市科哈特冲入一座清真寺，造成至少17人死亡，73人受伤。遇难者中包括七名警察和一名四岁儿童。枪手还袭击了附近的一个警察设施。

body.en:
A car-bomb attack on a mosque at a police compound in north-western Pakistan has killed at least 21 people and injured more than 100, officials say.

Fifteen police officers and a four-year-old child are among those killed in the suicide attack, which also involved gunmen firing on the police facility in the city of Kohat in the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan's APP news agency reported.

Video found by BBC Verify shows the site covered in rubble and people tending to casualties.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police suggested a faction of the Tehrik-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), also known as the Pakistani Taliban, carried out the attack.

A car loaded with explosives rammed into the entrance of the mosque at about 13:15 local time (08:15 GMT), police say. Friday prayers were taking place at the time.

At least six of the attackers were killed in the explosion and the gun battle that followed, according to a Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police spokesperson.

In a post on X, the force said it was "determined to foil the nefarious designs of Fitna-al-Khawarij" - the designation used by officials to refer to the Pakistani Taliban.

The group was set up in 2007 with the aim of enforcing its strict version of Islamic law and is allied with al-Qaeda and the Afghan Taliban.

Pakistan's President Asif Ali Zardari expressed "his best wishes for the swift recovery of those injured in the explosion" in a statement, and called for the "complete elimination" of foreign-backed terrorists.

A UN spokesman said Secretary-General António Guterres "strongly condemns" the bombing and that "attacks targeting civilians and places of worship are unacceptable".

In February, officials accused the Pakistani Taliban of being behind a series of attacks in the country, including the suicide bombing of a Shia mosque in Islamabad in which more than 30 people were killed.

Faisal Karim Kundi, governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, said on Friday the province had endured "immense sacrifices in the fight against terrorism".

Militancy in Pakistan's border areas has risen sharply in recent months, with armed groups targeting the military and police.

Islamabad says militants use Afghanistan as a safe haven to train and plan attacks in Pakistan.

Afghanistan's Taliban government denies the accusation and says militant groups are a domestic problem for Pakistan.
body.zh: 据巴基斯坦通讯社报道，一辆满载炸药的车辆冲进巴基斯坦西北部一座清真寺，造成至少 17 人死亡、73 人受伤。 据巴基斯坦美联社（APP）报道，袭击中包括七名警察和一名四岁儿童，枪手还向开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省科哈特市的一处警察设施内开枪。 BBC verify 发现的视频显示，该地点被瓦砾覆盖，人们正在处理伤员。 巴基斯坦总统阿西夫·阿里·扎尔达里在一份声明中表达了“他对爆炸中受伤人员迅速康复的最良好祝愿”。 据报道，爆炸发生在当地时间 13:15 左右（格林威治标准时间 08:15），当时正在进行周五祈祷。 据路透社报道，开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省警察督察佐勒菲卡尔·哈米德称这是一次“自杀式袭击”，该社还报道说，警方已确认所有七名袭击者在爆炸和随后的枪战中丧生。 据APP报道，警方发言人表示，爆炸发生后，七名武装分子试图潜入警察设施。 近几个月来，巴基斯坦边境地区的武装活动急剧增加，武装团体针对军队和警察。 伊斯兰堡表示，武装分子利用阿富汗作为训练和策划袭击巴基斯坦的安全港。阿富汗塔利班政府否认这一指控，并表示激进组织是巴基斯坦的国内问题。

reflection.en: The horrific attack in Kohat, Pakistan, where a vehicle laden with explosives struck a mosque, killing innocent people including a child, is a stark reminder of the destructive cycles of violence. In the face of such evil, the call to overcome it with good, rather than retaliating in kind, remains a profound challenge and a divine imperative. May Yahweh...
reflection.zh: 巴基斯坦科哈特发生的这起可怕袭击事件，一辆载有爆炸物的车辆撞入清真寺，造成包括儿童在内的无辜生命丧生，这是暴力循环毁灭性的严峻提醒。面对这样的邪恶，不以恶报恶、反而以善胜恶的呼召，仍然是一个深刻的挑战和神圣的命令。愿雅伟赐予哀伤者平安与安慰，并赐予所有寻求打破这些循环的人智慧。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Trump bans CNN, MS Now and Politico from the White House
title.zh: 特朗普禁止CNN、MS Now和Politico进入白宫

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has banned CNN, MS Now, and Politico from the White House, citing their coverage as 'FAKE NEWS.' This action represents a significant restriction of access for major traditional news media.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已禁止CNN、MS Now和Politico进入白宫，称其报道为“假新闻”。此举代表着对主要传统新闻媒体访问的重大限制。

body.en: US president has overseen an unprecedented restriction of access for major traditional news media since start of second term US politics live – latest updates In his latest attack on the US constitution’s first amendment and the press, Donald Trump has announced that he is banning outlets CNN, MS Now and Politico from the White House over their coverage. In a post on his Truth Social platform on Friday afternoon, the US president said he was expelling the news outlets over what he called their “constant ‘reporting’ FAKE NEWS!” and threatened that bans for others outlets could follow. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自第二任期开始以来，美国总统对主要传统新闻媒体实施了前所未有的限制 美国政治直播 - 最新动态 在对美国宪法第一修正案和媒体的最新攻击中，唐纳德·特朗普宣布，他将禁止 CNN、MS Now 和 Politico 等媒体进入白宫，因为它们的报道。周五下午，美国总统在其“真相社交”平台上发帖称，他将驱逐这些新闻媒体，因为他称这些媒体“不断‘报道’假新闻！”并威胁称其他媒体也可能会受到禁令。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The press plays a vital role in a democracy, and Ephesians 4:25 calls believers to 'put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another.' When access is restricted and accusations of 'fake news' fly, it becomes harder for the public to discern truth, challenging the very foundation of informed discourse.
reflection.zh: 新闻媒体在民主社会中扮演着至关重要的角色，而以弗所书4章25节呼吁信徒“各人与邻舍说实话”。当媒体被限制进入，并且充斥着“假新闻”的指控时，公众辨别真理就变得更加困难，这挑战了知情讨论的根本基础。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Iran's 'new Hezbollah:' How powerful are the Houthis now?
title.zh: 伊朗的“新真主党”：胡塞武装现在有多强大？

summary.en: Following Houthi victories in Yemen, the group's significance within Iran's 'axis of resistance' has increased, potentially elevating them to a more central role than Lebanon's Hezbollah.
summary.zh: 继胡塞武装在也门取得胜利后，该组织在伊朗“抵抗轴心”中的重要性日益增加，可能使其地位超越黎巴嫩真主党。

body.en:
After Houthi victories in Yemen, the group's importance in the US-Iran war has grown. Previously Lebanon's Hezbollah was considered most significant in Iran's "axis of resistance." Now the Houthis are rising to the top.

After recent events in Yemen , a small crowd marched down an Iraqi street holding signs that were almost identical to those seen not too long ago further south.

The signs said, "death to America" and insulted Saudi Arabia and Israel , with slogans very similar to those used by the Houthi rebel group in Yemen. The men in the Iraqi video are members of one of Iraq's Shiite Muslim paramilitary groups.

Both the Iraqi paramilitaries and the Houthi group in Yemen are part of what is known as the "axis of resistance" in the Middle East, groups supported by Iran that often act at Iran's behest. Other members are Hezbollah in Lebanon and Hamas in Gaza .

After the  US and Israel began attacking Iran  in late February 2026, "axis of resistance" members responded by targeting sites associated with the US or Israel. But up until recently, the Houthi group had remained more or less on the sidelines.

However their latest military campaign, which has seen Houthi fighters take further control of the Yemeni coast and several islands in the Red Sea , "sets up conditions to establish… an axis of resistance-controlled body of water as part of [an] effort to assert control over regional oil exports," US-based research organization  the Institute for the Study of War explained last week.

Iran and the US are already fighting for control over the Strait of Hormuz , another important waterway for oil exports and trade.

In Iran, hardline regime-supporting newspapers published laudatory articles about the Houthis' territorial gains.

The gains "greatly increased the weight of Sanaa [the Yemeni capital, under Houthi control] as a branch of resistance in the ongoing regional war," one of Iran's most conservative newspapers, Kayhan , wrote.

Supporters of the Iranian government have been holding nightly gatherings in major cities across the country since the US-Iran war began and this week, at the 200th such event, crowds chanted "you are my soul, O Yemen!"

This was the kind of praise previously lavished on another "axis of resistance" group, Hezbollah. But Hezbollah's armed faction, degraded by recent Israeli attacks and the loss of their base in Syria, looks less intimidating these days.

And the Houthis now appear to be doing things that Hezbollah couldn't — for example, bringing down a Saudi F-15 fighter jet this week using a missile the group said it modified itself. Hezbollah has managed to shoot down large Israeli drones and has targeted fighter jets but never hit any.

Could the Houthis be taking Hezbollah's place...
body.zh: 胡塞武装在也门取得胜利后，该组织在美伊战争中的重要性日益增强。此前，黎巴嫩真主党被认为是伊朗“抵抗轴心”中最重要的组织。现在胡塞武装正在崛起。 在也门最近发生的事件之后，一小群人在伊拉克的一条街道上游行，他们举着的标语与不久前在南部地区看到的标语几乎一模一样。 这些标语上写着“美国去死”，并侮辱沙特阿拉伯和以色列，其口号与也门胡塞叛乱组织使用的口号非常相似。伊拉克视频中的男子是伊拉克什叶派穆斯林准军事组织之一的成员。 伊拉克准军事组织和也门胡塞武装都是中东“抵抗轴心”的一部分，这些组织得到伊朗支持，经常按照伊朗的要求行事。其他成员包括黎巴嫩真主党和加沙哈马斯。 2026 年 2 月下旬，美国和以色列开始攻击伊朗后，“抵抗轴心”成员的回应是瞄准与美国或以色列相关的网站。但直到最近，胡塞武装仍或多或少地处于观望状态。 然而，胡塞武装分子最近的军事行动进一步控制了也门海岸和红海的几个岛屿，“为建立……阻力控制的水域轴线创造了条件，作为控制地区石油出口的努力的一部分，”美国研究组织战争研究所上周解释道。 伊朗和美国已经在争夺霍尔木兹海峡的控制权，这是石油出口和贸易的另一条重要水道。 在伊朗，支持强硬派政权的报纸发表了赞扬胡塞武装夺取领土的文章。 伊朗最保守的报纸之一《凯汉》写道，这些成果“大大增加了萨那（胡塞武装控制下的也门首都）作为当前地区战争中抵抗力量的一个分支的影响力”。 自美伊战争爆发以来，伊朗政府的支持者每晚都在全国各大城市举行集会，本周，在第 200 次此类活动中，人群高呼“也门啊，你是我的灵魂！” 这是先前对另一个“抵抗轴心”组织真主党的赞扬。但真主党的武装派系因最近以色列的袭击和叙利亚基地的丧失而受到削弱，如今看起来不再那么令人生畏了。 胡塞武装现在似乎正在做真主党做不到的事情——例如，本周使用真主党自称改装的导弹击落了一架沙特 F-15 战斗机。真主党成功击落了以色列大型无人机，并瞄准了战斗机，但从未击中任何一架。 胡塞武装可能会取代真主党吗？

reflection.en: The escalating influence of groups like the Houthis in regional conflicts can feel overwhelming, as if the cycle of war is unending. Yet, the ancient promise remains: 'He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth.' This offers a profound hope that even the most entrenched conflicts are ultimately subject to a higher power's sovereign will.
reflection.zh: 像胡塞武装这样的团体在地区冲突中日益增长的影响力，可能会让人感到不堪重负，仿佛战争的循环永无止境。然而，古老的应许依然存在：“他使地极止息争战。”这提供了一个深刻的希望，即便是最根深蒂固的冲突，也最终会屈服于更高权柄的主权旨意。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Is the Kennedy Center losing 'hundreds of millions of dollars'?
title.zh: 肯尼迪中心是否损失了“数亿美元”？

summary.en: Records in 2024 show the venue had a surplus of millions of dollars once contributions and grants had been factored in, despite former President Trump's claims of significant financial losses.
summary.zh: 尽管前总统特朗普声称肯尼迪中心有巨额亏损，但2024年的记录显示，在计入捐款和拨款后，该场馆仍有数百万美元的盈余。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has claimed the Kennedy Center in Washington DC has been losing "tens of millions of dollars, even hundreds of millions of dollars" for years.

Trump, who wants his name on the famous performing arts venue, was photographed onboard Air Force One looking at a poster with a headline that appeared to tout the demolition of the site.

Federal audit records for 2024 show that, despite having "an operating deficit", it had a surplus of millions of dollars - as Aisha Sembhi explains.

Design by Mesut Ersöz and Henry Esterson. Additional reporting by Tom Edgington.
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普声称，华盛顿特区的肯尼迪中心多年来一直损失“数千万美元，甚至数亿美元”。 特朗普希望自己的名字出现在这个著名的表演艺术场地上，他被拍到在空军一号上看着一张海报，海报的标题似乎是在宣传拆除该场地。 正如 Ais​​ha Sembhi 解释的那样，2024 年的联邦审计记录显示，尽管存在“运营赤字”，但仍有数百万美元的盈余。 由 Mesut Ersöz 和 Henry Esterson 设计。汤姆·埃丁顿的补充报道。

reflection.en: Public figures often make bold claims, but accountability rests on verifiable facts. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who is robbed." This principle reminds us to seek truth and fairness, especially when public statements impact institutions and public trust.
reflection.zh: 公众人物常常发表大胆的言论，但问责制依赖于可验证的事实。耶利米书22:3呼吁领袖“施行公平和公义，从欺压者的手中拯救被欺压的”。这一原则提醒我们，尤其是在公开声明影响机构和公众信任时，要寻求真理和公正。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: San Diego police investigate case of family of three found fatally shot in home
title.zh: 圣地亚哥警方调查一户三口在家中遭枪击身亡案

summary.en: A Navy veteran, his wife, and their child were found dead from gunshot wounds in their San Diego home on Wednesday morning. Relatives reported the veteran, David Voight, was suffering from PTSD, and investigators found a weapon at the scene.
summary.zh: 周三上午，一名海军退伍军人、他的妻子和他们的孩子在圣地亚哥的家中被发现死于枪伤。亲属报告称，退伍军人大卫·沃伊特患有创伤后应激障碍（PTSD），调查人员在现场发现了一件武器。

body.en: Navy veteran David Voight, his wife, Amy, and their child were found dead as relatives report Voight was suffering from PTSD Authorities are investigating what led to the tragic case of a family who was found fatally shot in their San Diego area home on Wednesday morning. The San Diego police department identified the family as Amy Voight, 54, and David Voight, 56, and the couple’s 13-year-old daughter. The family died of gunshot wounds, police said, and investigators found a weapon in the residence. Continue reading...
body.zh: 海军退伍军人戴维·沃特 (David Voight) 及其妻子艾米 (Amy) 和孩子被发现死亡，亲属称沃特患有创伤后应激障碍 (PTSD)。 周三上午，一家人在圣地亚哥地区的家中被发现被枪杀，当局正在调查这起悲惨案件的原因。圣地亚哥警察局确认这家人是 54 岁的艾米·沃伊特 (Amy Voight) 和 56 岁的大卫·沃伊特 (David Voight)，以及这对夫妇 13 岁的女儿。警方称，这家人死于枪伤，调查人员在住所发现了一把武器。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a family's tragic end, marked by violence and the shadow of PTSD, speaks to a deep human pain. In such moments of profound grief and despair, the Psalmist reminds us that Yahweh is not distant but near to the brokenhearted. May those who grieve find solace in His presence, and may we, as a community, offer support and compassion to those...
reflection.zh: 一个家庭的悲剧性结局，伴随着暴力和创伤后应激障碍的阴影，触及了深刻的人类痛苦。在如此深切的悲伤和绝望时刻，诗人提醒我们，雅伟并非遥远，而是临近心灵破碎和灵里忧伤的人。愿那些哀恸的人在他里面找到安慰，愿我们作为一个社群，向那些与看不见的伤痛搏斗的人伸出援手，给予关怀。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

title.en: Why Europe has been absent from the great AI safety debate
title.zh: 为什么欧洲缺席了关于人工智能安全的重要辩论

summary.en: Europe faces a dilemma over artificial intelligence: shun the technology and risk falling behind in economic growth, or embrace it and become dependent on tools developed by the US and China. This choice is complicated by the ongoing global debate on AI safety, which could render the decision moot if worst-case...
summary.zh: 欧洲在人工智能问题上面临两难：要么回避这项技术，冒着经济增长落后的风险；要么拥抱它，并依赖于美国和中国开发的工具。关于人工智能安全的持续全球辩论使这一选择变得复杂，如果最坏的情况发生，无论欧洲采取何种立场，这项技术都将影响该大陆，从而可能使这一选择变得无关紧要。

body.en: Though Europe has measures that address how consumers might encounter AI, technology will impact them if the worst scenarios bear Europe’s dilemma over AI was rendered in stark terms this week. The head of the continent’s central bank, Christine Lagarde, said Europeans have two options: shun the technology and lose out on growth; or embrace it and become dependent on tools developed by the US and China. The great debate over AI safety that has erupted in recent days threatens to make the choice moot. If the worst scenarios come to bear – and experts have differing views on this – then the technology will impact the continent regardless. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管欧洲已经采取措施解决消费者如何遇到人工智能的问题，但如果本周欧洲在人工智能方面面临的最糟糕的情况以赤裸裸的方式呈现出来，那么技术将会对他们产生影响。欧洲大陆央行行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德表示，欧洲人有两种选择：避开技术并失去增长机会；或者拥抱它并依赖美国和中国开发的工具。最近几天爆发的关于人工智能安全的激烈争论可能会让这一选择变得毫无意义。如果最坏的情况发生——专家们对此有不同的看法——那么这项技术无论如何都会影响非洲大陆。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Europe's hesitation in the AI safety debate reflects a broader challenge: how to engage with powerful, rapidly developing technologies. Like metals tested in a furnace, nations and societies are put to the test by the potential and peril of AI. The question is not just about economic growth or dependency, but about the wisdom and ethical framework guiding...
reflection.zh: 欧洲在人工智能安全辩论中的犹豫，反映了一个更广泛的挑战：如何应对强大且快速发展的技术。正如金属在熔炉中被试炼一样，国家和社会在人工智能的潜力和危险面前受到了考验。问题不仅在于经济增长或依赖性，还在于指导我们拥抱这些变革性工具的智慧和伦理框架。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Airport malaria in Germany remains infrequent
title.zh: 德国机场疟疾仍属罕见

summary.en: An outbreak of malaria at Frankfurt Airport this summer has raised alarm. Experts believe parasites probably arrived in a passenger's luggage. But with the onset of fall, the risks of contracting the disease are low. Eight people are known to have contracted malaria in the vicinity of Frankfurt Airport in central...
summary.zh: 今年夏天，法兰克福机场爆发疟疾，引起了人们的警觉。专家认为寄生虫很可能是随着乘客的行李一同抵达的。但随着秋季的到来，感染该疾病的风险很低。自7月以来，在德国中部法兰克福机场附近已有8人感染疟疾，其中3人死亡。受影响者多为机场运营商Fraport的员工。法兰克福公共卫生部门认为此次疫情是“机场疟疾”所致，即携带疟疾寄生虫...

body.en:
An outbreak of malaria at Frankfurt Airport this summer has raised alarm. Experts believe parasites probably arrived in a passenger's luggage. But with the onset of fall, the risks of contracting the disease are low.

Eight people are known to have contracted malaria in the vicinity of Frankfurt Airport in central Germany since July; three of them have died . Those affected are mostly employees of the airport operator Fraport.

The Frankfurt Public Health Department believes the outbreak is due to "airport malaria," which occurs when a female Anopheles mosquito carrying the malaria parasite travels by aircraft to a country where the disease is not common from one where it is , bites a person and infects their red blood cells. 

"We are dealing with a very rare occurrence, not a new frequent disease in Germany," said Achim Hörauf, the director of the Institute for Medical Microbiology, Immunology and Parasitology at Bonn's University Hospital (UKB), in a press release.

The last documented case of airport malaria in Germany before the current ones was in 2023, according to the Epidemiologisches Bulletin of the Robert Koch Institute (RKI), an online journal that regularly provides information on infectious diseases and public health.

Normally, those with the disease in Germany were infected elsewhere and brought it back during a long-haul trip.

But a mosquito  can make its way to Germany as a "stowaway" if it was trapped in a suitcase or in clothing. Hörauf said that under certain circumstances, it might be able to survive in warmer areas of an airport.

According to a UKB press release, the cases in Frankfurt involve malaria tropica , which is considered to be the most dangerous and potentially life-threatening form of malaria.

To contract the disease, a person needs to be bitten by a female anopheles mosquito infected with the  Plasmodium falciparum parasite. This pathogen passes to the human and then attacks the red blood vessels.

"Simply put, it can lead to many small blockages in the blood vessels," explained Hörauf. "Depending on which organ is affected, various serious complications can arise."

Fluid can accumulate in the lungs, or neurological damage can result if the blood vessels of the brain are affected. Acute kidney failure is also possible. About 20% of those affected die if the disease is left untreated.

"If a diagnosis is made in time, there can be targeted treatment," Hörauf said. "If the disease is overlooked , however, it can very quickly take a severe turn."

At first, symptoms are not specific, resembling those of the flu: sudden high fever, chills, headaches and muscle pain. Nausea, vomiting and diarrhea are also possible.

The Frankfurt Public Health Department has advised anybody who lives or...
body.zh: 今年夏天法兰克福机场爆发的疟疾引起了人们的警惕。专家认为寄生虫可能是通过乘客的行李到达的。但随着秋季的到来，感染这种疾病的风险很低。 自7月以来，德国中部法兰克福机场附近已知有8人感染疟疾；其中三人已经死亡。受影响的主要是机场运营商法兰克福机场集团的员工。 法兰克福公共卫生部门认为，此次疫情的爆发是由于“机场疟疾”，当一只携带疟疾寄生虫的雌性按蚊从该疾病所在的国家乘飞机前往该疾病不常见的国家，叮咬一个人并感染其红细胞时，就会发生这种情况。 波恩大学医院 (UKB) 医学微生物学、免疫学和寄生虫学研究所所长阿奇姆·霍劳夫 (Achim Hörauf) 在一份新闻稿中表示：“我们面对的是一种非常罕见的疾病，而不是德国的一种新的常见疾病。” 根据罗伯特·科赫研究所 (RKI) 的《流行病学公报》，该研究所定期提供传染病和公共卫生信息的在线期刊，该研究所在当前病例之前记录的德国最后一次机场疟疾病例发生在 2023 年。 通常情况下，那些在德国感染这种疾病的人会在其他地方受到感染，并在长途旅行中将病毒带回来。 但如果蚊子被困在手提箱或衣服里，它就会以“偷渡者”的身份进入德国。霍劳夫说，在某些情况下，它可能能够在机场较温暖的区域生存。 根据英国广播公司的新闻稿，法兰克福的病例涉及热带疟疾，这种疟疾被认为是最危险且可能危及生命的疟疾。 要感染这种疾病，一个人需要被感染恶性疟原虫寄生虫的雌性按蚊叮咬。这种病原体传播到人体，然后攻击红血管。 “简单来说，它会导致血管出现许多小堵塞，”霍劳夫解释道。 “根据受影响的器官，可能会出现各种严重的并发症。” 液体会积聚在肺部，如果大脑血管受到影响，可能会导致神经损伤。急性肾衰竭也是可能的。如果不及时治疗，大约 20% 的受影响者会死亡。 “如果及时诊断，就可以进行针对性治疗，”霍劳夫说。 “然而，如果这种疾病被忽视，它很快就会发生严重的转变。” 起初，症状并不具体，类似于流感：突然高烧、发冷、头痛和肌肉疼痛。恶心、呕吐和腹泻也可能发生。 法兰克福公共卫生部门已建议任何生活或...

reflection.en: The news from Frankfurt reports a cluster of malaria cases, tragically including three deaths among airport employees. This outbreak, though rare, highlights the vulnerability of communities to disease, even in unexpected places. It calls us to pray for those afflicted and for public health officials working to contain such threats, remembering that Yahweh...
reflection.zh: 法兰克福的报道称，当地爆发了一系列疟疾病例，不幸的是，其中包括三名机场员工的死亡。这次疫情虽然罕见，但凸显了社区在疾病面前的脆弱性，即使是在意想不到的地方。这促使我们为受影响者和致力于遏制此类威胁的公共卫生官员祈祷，并铭记雅伟是医治病人的那位。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
title.zh: 马克龙称俄罗斯针对欧洲的混合攻击正在加剧

summary.en: French President Emmanuel Macron has stated that Russia's hybrid attacks against Europe, including France, have intensified. He has ordered the government to develop a plan to protect critical infrastructure and defense industry sites, indicating that France will not leave these attacks without a response.
summary.zh: 法国总统马克龙表示，俄罗斯针对欧洲（包括法国）的混合攻击已加剧。他已下令政府制定一项保护关键基础设施和国防工业部门的计划，并表明法国不会对这些攻击置之不理。

body.en:
French President Emmanuel Macron has warned that the threat of hybrid attacks by Russia against Europe and France has intensified.

In a news conference at the Elysee Palace, Macron said he had ordered a plan to protect critical infrastructure and defence industry sites in the face of this threat.

He said France had been targeted by Russian hybrid attacks in the past few weeks which would not be left "without a response".

A growing number of European leaders have warned that Russia may be preparing attacks to test their commitment to supporting Ukraine.

Hybrid warfare or hybrid attacks are loose terms which tend to describe non-military methods, for example cyberattacks, sabotage or misinformation, designed to exert pressure and destabilise an adversary.

These are quite often employed using proxies, but Russia always denies involvement in such attacks despite growing evidence to the contrary.

The French president was speaking to journalists after meeting party leaders to discuss the security impact of the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine.

Macron mentioned last month's drone attack on Leipzig airport in Germany , blamed on Russia, and remarks by Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk suggesting Russia was planning drone and missile strikes against Poland and other countries on Nato's eastern flank.

"In recent weeks, the Russian hybrid threat against Europeans and against France has intensified," he said.

"The intent is to intimidate us and break our effort to support Ukraine. The result will be the exact opposite. We are not intimidated because we know that our security today and tomorrow is at stake in Ukraine."

On Thursday Tusk told Polish MPs that Russian plans included strikes by drones and missiles on countries supporting Ukraine. He said there was a "real risk" of such strikes on the territory of Nato countries, with Moscow then claiming that they were "accidental", in an attempt to split the alliance.

Last Sunday, a Russian drone hit a passenger train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and top European security officials had passed through along the same line.

Ukraine said all the passengers had been evacuated just minutes before the strike at Yahodyn, which hit the train's engine.

There have also been a number of suspicious fires at defence facilities from Italy to Estonia, with some of the affected countries blaming Russia .

Russian President Vladimir Putin has repeatedly said Russia does not plan to attack Europe, but Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov warned European nations against sending troops to Ukraine, which would be seen by Russia as a declaration of war.

"If Europe attacks Russia, it will be a completely different war, and it will be very short," he said.

Meanwhile on...
body.zh: 法国总统马克龙警告称，俄罗斯对欧洲和法国发动混合攻击的威胁已经加剧。 在爱丽舍宫举行的新闻发布会上，马克龙表示，面对这一威胁，他已下令制定一项计划，保护关键基础设施和国防工业场所。 他表示，过去几周，法国成为俄罗斯混合攻击的目标，俄罗斯不会“不做出回应”。 越来越多的欧洲领导人警告称，俄罗斯可能正在准备发动袭击，以测试他们支持乌克兰的承诺。 混合战争或混合攻击是宽松的术语，往往描述非军事方法，例如网络攻击、破坏或错误信息，旨在向对手施加压力并破坏其稳定。 这些攻击通常是通过代理来进行的，但俄罗斯始终否认参与此类攻击，尽管越来越多的证据表明事实并非如此。 法国总统在与党领导人会面讨论中东和乌克兰战争对安全的影响后对记者发表讲话。 马克龙提到了上个月德国莱比锡机场发生的无人机袭击事件，该袭击归咎于俄罗斯，以及波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克的言论，暗示俄罗斯正计划对波兰和北约东翼的其他国家进行无人机和导弹袭击。 “最近几周，俄罗斯对欧洲和法国的混合威胁有所加剧，”他说。 “其目的是恐吓我们，破坏我们支持乌克兰的努力。结果将完全相反。我们不会被吓倒，因为我们知道乌克兰今天和明天的安全都受到威胁。” 周四图斯克告诉波兰议员，俄罗斯的计划包括使用无人机和导弹对支持乌克兰的国家进行袭击。他表示，在北约国家领土上进行此类袭击存在“真正的风险”，莫斯科随后声称这些袭击是“意外的”，试图分裂该联盟。 上周日，在英国前首相鲍里斯·约翰逊和欧洲高级安全官员沿着同一条线路通过后不久，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰-波兰边境附近的一列客运列车。 乌克兰表示，就在雅霍丁发生罢工几分钟前，所有乘客已被疏散，这次罢工击中了火车的引擎。 从意大利到爱沙尼亚的国防设施也发生了多起可疑火灾，一些受影响的国家指责俄罗斯。 俄罗斯总统普京多次表示，俄罗斯不打算袭击欧洲，但外交部长拉夫罗夫警告欧洲国家不要向乌克兰派遣军队，这将被俄罗斯视为宣战。 “如果欧洲攻击俄罗斯，那将是一场完全不同的战争，而且时间会非常短，”他说。 与此同时...

reflection.en: The escalating threat of hybrid warfare, as described by President Macron, presents a complex challenge. It tempts nations to respond with similar tactics, potentially deepening cycles of conflict. The ancient wisdom to 'not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good' calls for a response rooted in resilience and strategic defense, rather than...
reflection.zh: 正如马克龙总统所描述的，混合战争威胁的加剧带来了严峻的挑战。它诱使各国采取类似的策略进行回应，可能加剧冲突的循环。古老的智慧‘不可被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶’，呼吁以韧性和战略防御为基础来回应，而非被动攻击，旨在缓和而非激化局势。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Ever more Israelis moving to and investing in Cyprus
title.zh: 越来越多的以色列人移居塞浦路斯并投资于塞浦路斯

summary.en: Over the past three years, a growing number of Israelis have been buying property and investing in Cyprus, with many choosing to relocate permanently. This trend is largely driven by the volatile situation and prolonged insecurity in Israel, particularly following the events of October 7, 2023, leading many to view...
summary.zh: 在过去的三年里，越来越多的以色列人在塞浦路斯购买房产并进行投资，许多人选择永久移居。这一趋势主要是由以色列动荡的局势和持续的不安全感所驱动，尤其是在2023年10月7日事件之后，许多人将塞浦路斯视为“B计划”。这种涌入已经开始影响塞浦路斯经济，并引起了当地民众的反应。

body.en:
Over the past three years, more and more Israelis have been purchasing property and investing in Cyprus, with many moving to the island permanently. How has this changed the Cypriot economy and how are locals responding?

The volatile situation in Israel and the prolonged sense of insecurity following the October 7, 2023 attacks and the wars that followed have prompted a growing number of Israelis to turn to the Republic of Cyprus .

For many, the nearby island is evolving from a holiday and investment destination into a place to settle permanently — and, in some cases, a "Plan B" in the event of a deterioration of the situation in Israel.

That is precisely how several Israelis who spoke to DW on condition of anonymity described their decision.

"I want to have a Plan B in case the situation in Israel gets more difficult," said one Israeli who recently bought a home in a large residential development in Cyprus's Limassol district.

Another pointed to Cyprus's proximity and familiarity: "It's a 40-minute flight, the same landscape, the same climate. It's like being in Israel without actually being there."

A third linked his move to business, saying that many Israeli companies have transferred some of their operations to Cyprus, making it easier for them to do business with EU countries.

According to estimates cited by Israeli media , at least 3,000 Israeli families now live permanently in Cyprus, with their number increasing by several hundred each year.

Israeli media reports also speak of tens of thousands of Israelis who have purchased property on the island. The newspaper Israel Hayom has reported that around 20,000 Israelis own property in Cyprus without living there year-round.

Figures from the Cyprus Land Registry presented to parliament show that between 2021 and 2024, a total of 3,851 property transfers and sale contracts involving Israeli buyers were recorded in the coastal districts of Larnaca, Paphos and Limassol alone.

But Israeli interest in Cyprus extends beyond apartments and holiday homes to land, tourism developments and major investment projects.

One of the most prominent examples is the Israeli hotel group Fattal, whose investments in Cyprus are estimated to run into hundreds of millions of euros and include hotels in Limassol, Paphos and Larnaca.

In Larnaca, investors with Israeli interests are also behind the redevelopment of the historic Palm Beach hotel, an investment of more than €110 million ($126 million), as well as the roughly €40 million Aqua Residences project, which foresees the construction of two 15-story towers along the seafront.

In the Limassol district, an Israeli investor is planning to revive Trozena, a village that has been abandoned for decades, by restoring around 60 homes and developing tourism...
body.zh: 过去三年来，越来越多的以色列人在塞浦路斯购买房产和投资，其中许多人永久移居该岛。这如何改变了塞浦路斯的经济？当地人有何反应？ 以色列局势的动荡以及 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击和随后的战争造成的长期不安全感促使越来越多的以色列人转向塞浦路斯共和国。 对于许多人来说，附近的岛屿正在从度假和投资目的地演变为永久定居地，在某些情况下，这是以色列局势恶化时的“B 计划”。 几位不愿透露姓名的以色列人正是这样描述他们的决定的。 “我希望有一个备用计划，以防以色列的局势变得更加困难，”一位最近在塞浦路斯利马索尔区的一个大型住宅开发区买了房子的以色列人说。 另一位则指出塞浦路斯的邻近性和熟悉性：“只需 40 分钟的飞行，同样的风景，同样的气候。就像身处以色列，但实际上却身在其间。” 第三个人将他的搬迁与商业联系起来，称许多以色列公司已将部分业务转移到塞浦路斯，使他们更容易与欧盟国家开展业务。 据以色列媒体估计，目前至少有3000个以色列家庭永久居住在塞浦路斯，并且这个数字每年都在增加数百个。 以色列媒体报道还提到数以万计的以色列人在岛上购买了房产。 Israel Hayom 报纸报道称，约有 20,000 名以色列人在塞浦路斯拥有房产，但并不常年居住在那里。 塞浦路斯土地登记处向议会提交的数据显示，2021年至2024年期间，仅在拉纳卡、帕福斯和利马索尔沿海地区就记录了总共3,851份涉及以色列买家的财产转让和销售合同。 但以色列对塞浦路斯的兴趣不仅限于公寓和度假屋，还包括土地、旅游开发和重大投资项目。 最突出的例子之一是以色列酒店集团 Fattal，其在塞浦路斯的投资估计达数亿欧元，其中包括利马索尔、帕福斯和拉纳卡的酒店。 在拉纳卡，具有以色列利益的投资者也支持历史悠久的棕榈滩酒店的重建，投资超过 1.1 亿欧元（1.26 亿美元），以及约 4000 万欧元的 Aqua Residences 项目，该项目预计将在海滨建造两座 15 层塔楼。 在利马索尔地区，一位以色列投资者正计划通过修复约 60 所房屋并发展旅游业，重振特罗泽纳 (Trozena) 这个已废弃数十年的村庄……

reflection.en: The movement of Israelis to Cyprus, seeking stability and a new home amidst conflict, echoes the ancient biblical call to welcome the stranger. Deuteronomy 10:19 reminds us to love the foreigner, for we ourselves were once foreigners in Egypt. This principle calls for compassion and hospitality towards those displaced or seeking refuge, recognizing our...
reflection.zh: 以色列人为了在冲突中寻求稳定和新家园而移居塞浦路斯，这呼应了圣经中欢迎陌生人的古老呼召。申命记10:19提醒我们当爱寄居的，因为我们曾在埃及地也作过寄居的。这一原则呼吁对那些流离失所或寻求庇护的人们怀有同情心和好客之心，认识到我们共同的人性和过去脆弱的经历。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Canada and EU: A look at the bloc's special relationships
title.zh: 加拿大与欧盟：一窥欧盟的特殊关系

summary.en: Despite geographical distance, Canada and the EU are strengthening political ties, with discussions of associate membership. This closer relationship is motivated by shared values and a desire for a united front in addressing global challenges, particularly in relation to the US administration's trade policies.
summary.zh: 尽管地理上相距遥远，加拿大和欧盟正在加强政治联系，并讨论准成员国的可能性。这种更紧密的关系是由共同的价值观以及在应对全球挑战（尤其是在美国政府的贸易政策方面）时寻求统一战线的愿望所驱动的。

body.en:
Though Canada may be some distance from Europe geographically, closer political ties are in the cards. With talk of an associate membership, DW takes a look at other arrangements the EU has with particular countries.

Canada and the EU "see the world with the same eyes," according to European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen .

"Our commitment to the rule of law, and our unyielding defense of human dignity, individual freedom and democracy share the same deep roots, the same unwavering dedication,"  Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney  said.

In that spirit, and with both parties grasping for an effective way to deal with Donald Trump and his tariffs , von der Leyen floated the idea that Canada could become the European Union's first associate member on Thursday.

Given the concept of associate membership does not yet exist, it's difficult to determine exactly what that would mean. Germany proposed a similar arrangement for Ukraine earlier this year, only for Volodymyr Zelenskyy to reject the idea on the grounds that the country wants full membership.

Though not officially recognized as associates, there are plenty of countries that have strong ties or agreements with the bloc. DW looks at some of them and how they work.

Under this model, the ‘European Free Trade Association (EFTA)' countries are part of the EU's internal market, so people, goods and services can move freely in the Schengen area. The three countries also follow many EU rules in areas like tourism, environment and education.

But there are some key distinctions. The countries have no part in the decision-making process, bar some input into policy preparation, such as participation in expert groups. They are also not in the customs union, do not use the Euro and are not bound by the EU's common trade policy or justice laws. Iceland held a referendum on whether to go for full membership last month, but the government's push to do so failed and they remain an EFTA country.

While it borders four EU member states (Germany, Italy, France and Austria), Switzerland has never been a full member. Instead, more than 120 bilateral deals have been agreed upon by the EU and Switzerland over the last 50 years. These relate to areas such as trade, transport, security and education. A new package of deals was finalized last year, 20 years after they were last agreed.

More than 1.5 million EU citizens live and work in Switzerland, while 466,200 Swiss have gone the other way. That is possible as Switzerland is also part of the Schengen area , allowing for free movement of people across borders.

Switzerland makes financial contributions to a number of EU member states that joined after expansion in 2004, mostly in the east of Europe, but it has no EU voting rights and...
body.zh: 尽管加拿大在地理上距离欧洲可能有一段距离，但更密切的政治联系是有可能的。在谈及准成员资格时，德国之声考察了欧盟与特定国家之间的其他安排。 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩 (Ursula von der Leyen) 表示，加拿大和欧盟“用同样的眼睛看世界”。 加拿大总理马克·卡尼表示：“我们对法治的承诺，以及我们对人类尊严、个人自由和民主的坚定捍卫，有着同样深厚的根源和同样坚定不移的奉献精神。” 本着这种精神，在双方都在寻求一种有效的方式来应对唐纳德·特朗普及其关税的情况下，冯德莱恩于周四提出了加拿大可以成为欧盟第一个准成员的想法。 鉴于准会员资格的概念尚不存在，因此很难确定这到底意味着什么。德国今年早些时候向乌克兰提出了类似的安排，但弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基以该国希望成为正式成员国为由拒绝了这一想法。 尽管没有被官方承认为伙伴国，但仍有许多国家与欧盟有着密切的联系或协议。德国之声研究了其中的一些以及它们的工作原理。 在这种模式下，“欧洲自由贸易联盟（EFTA）”国家是欧盟内部市场的一部分，因此人员、商品和服务可以在申根区内自由流动。这三个国家在旅游、环境和教育等领域也遵守许多欧盟规则。 但也有一些关键的区别。这些国家不参与决策过程，禁止对政策制定提供一些投入，例如参加专家组。它们也不属于关税同盟，不使用欧元，并且不受欧盟共同贸易政策或司法法的约束。冰岛上个月就是否加入欧洲自由贸易联盟举行了全民公投，但政府的努力失败了，他们仍然是欧洲自由贸易联盟国家。 虽然瑞士与四个欧盟成员国（德国、意大利、法国和奥地利）接壤，但它从未成为正式成员国。相反，过去 50 年来，欧盟和瑞士达成了 120 多项双边协议。这些涉及贸易、运输、安全和教育等领域。一系列新的交易于去年敲定，距上次达成一致已过去 20 年。 超过 150 万欧盟公民在瑞士生活和工作，而 466,200 名瑞士人却选择了另一条路。这是可能的，因为瑞士也是申根区的一部分，允许人员跨境自由流动。 瑞士向 2004 年扩张后加入的一些欧盟成员国提供财政捐助，其中大部分位于东欧，但它没有欧盟投票权，而且……

reflection.en: The desire for closer political ties between Canada and the EU, rooted in shared commitments to the rule of law and human dignity, reflects a yearning for cooperation and mutual support in a complex world. This pursuit of common ground, as expressed by leaders like Ursula von der Leyen and Mark Carney, echoes the beatitude for peacemakers, reminding us that...
reflection.zh: 加拿大和欧盟之间对更紧密政治关系的渴望，源于对法治和人类尊严的共同承诺，这反映了在一个复杂世界中对合作和相互支持的追求。这种寻求共同点的努力，正如冯德莱恩和马克·卡尼等领导人所表达的那样，呼应了使人和睦者有福的教导，提醒我们建立桥梁和促进理解是一项神圣的呼召。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Ireland's RTÉ to boycott Eurovision over Israel inclusion for second year
title.zh: 爱尔兰RTÉ因以色列参赛连续第二年抵制欧洲歌唱大赛

summary.en: Irish public broadcaster RTÉ announced it will not send an act to or broadcast the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, for the second consecutive year, due to the ongoing conflict and loss of life in Gaza.
summary.zh: 爱尔兰公共广播公司RTÉ宣布，由于加沙持续的冲突和生命损失，该公司将连续第二年不派代表参加或转播2027年欧洲歌唱大赛。

body.en:
Ireland will not participate in or broadcast next year's Eurovision Song Contest, public broadcaster RTÉ said, citing the "ongoing loss of lives in Gaza".

The country, which also snubbed the 2026 competition over Israel's participation, will join the Netherlands in skipping the world's biggest live televised music event , which has been hit by a string of withdrawals and controversies in recent years.

"RTÉ will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, nor will RTÉ broadcast the competition," the broadcaster said on Thursday.

"RTÉ feels that Ireland's participation cannot be justified given the appalling and ongoing loss of lives in Gaza and the humanitarian crisis there which continues to put the lives of so many civilians at risk," the statement said.

RTÉ quoted Eurovision Song Contest director Martin Green as saying that the European Broadcasting Union (EBU), which organises the event, regretted but respected RTÉ's decision.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"They remain a valued part of our family and will be missed," RTÉ reported Green as saying.

Earlier this month, the EBU said it was excluding any country involved in an armed conflict from hosting the competition.

Israel, which has been at war in Gaza since 2023, came close to winning the competition in both 2025 and 2026, ultimately finishing second on each occasion .

However, the Dutch broadcaster said the exclusion of countries in conflict from hosting was not "sufficient", adding that Eurovision could "no longer be considered neutral" given the divisions over the Gaza conflict.

Since its launch in 1955, Eurovision has become the ultimate pop platform, catapulting Swedish icons ABBA to worldwide fame and boosting the likes of Celine Dion, Cliff Richard and Olivia Newton-John.

Next year's event will take place on 15 May in Burgas, Bulgaria's Black Sea city.

This year's competition drew 131 million viewers, down 35 million from the year before, after five countries boycotted it over Israel's participation .

The Netherlands, Iceland, Spain, Ireland and Slovenia all pulled out of the 2026 contest, with the latter three refusing to broadcast the show at all.

SBS, an associate member of EBU and Australia's official broadcaster of the competition, has confirmed it will broadcast Eurovision in 2027.

SBS participated in the 2026 edition, despite calls for Australia to boycott the competition .

"Our position remains that, as a public broadcaster, making a decision to be involved based on the inclusion or exclusion of any country would undermine SBS's editorial independence and impartiality," an SBS spokesperson said in December...
body.zh: 公共广播公司 RTÉ 表示，爱尔兰将不会参加或转播明年的欧洲歌唱大赛，理由是“加沙正在发生人员伤亡”。 该国还因以色列的参赛而冷落了2026年的比赛，并将与荷兰一起缺席这项世界上最大的现场电视音乐盛会，该盛会近年来受到一系列退出和争议的打击。 该广播公司周四表示：“RTÉ 将不会参加 2027 年欧洲歌唱大赛，也不会转播比赛。” 声明称：“RTÉ认为，鉴于加沙地区令人震惊的持续生命损失以及那里的人道主义危机继续使许多平民的生命处于危险之中，爱尔兰的参与是不合理的。” RTÉ援引欧洲歌唱大赛总监马丁·格林的话说，组织此次活动的欧洲广播联盟（EBU）对此表示遗憾，但尊重RTÉ的决定。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据《RTÉ》报道，格林表示：“他们仍然是我们家庭的重要组成部分，我们会想念他们。” 本月早些时候，欧洲联盟表示，将排除任何卷入武装冲突的国家主办比赛。 自 2023 年以来加沙一直处于战争状态的以色列在 2025 年和 2026 年都差点赢得比赛，最终两次获得第二名。 然而，这家荷兰广播公司表示，将冲突国家排除在主办之外还“不够”，并补充说，鉴于加沙冲突的分歧，欧洲电视网“不再被视为中立”。 自 1955 年推出以来，欧洲歌唱大赛已成为终极流行音乐平台，使瑞典偶像 ABBA 享誉全球，并培养了席琳·迪翁、克里夫·理查德和奥利维亚·牛顿·约翰等人。 明年的活动将于 5 月 15 日在保加利亚黑海城市布尔加斯举行。 今年的比赛吸引了 1.31 亿观众，比上年减少了 3500 万，此前有五个国家因以色列参赛而抵制比赛。 荷兰、冰岛、西班牙、爱尔兰和斯洛文尼亚都退出了 2026 年的比赛，后三个国家根本拒绝转播该节目。 SBS 是 EBU 的准会员，也是澳大利亚比赛的官方转播商，已确认将在 2027 年转播欧洲电视网。 尽管有人呼吁澳大利亚抵制比赛，SBS 还是参加了 2026 年的比赛。 SBS 发言人去年 12 月表示：“我们的立场仍然是，作为一家公共广播公司，根据纳入或排除任何国家做出参与决定将损害 SBS 的编辑独立性和公正性。”

reflection.en: RTÉ's decision to boycott the Eurovision Song Contest, citing the ongoing loss of life in Gaza, highlights a broadcaster's moral stance. This action reflects a principle of prioritizing conscience and humanitarian concerns over participation in a widely watched cultural event. It echoes the sentiment of obeying a higher moral calling, even when it means...
reflection.zh: RTÉ决定抵制欧洲歌唱大赛，并以加沙持续的生命损失为由，凸显了广播公司的道德立场。此举体现了在参与备受瞩目的文化活动时，将良知和人道主义关切置于优先地位的原则。这呼应了即使意味着退出一个平台，也要服从更高道德召唤的精神。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: The bigger story behind Donald Trump's Kennedy Center clash
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普肯尼迪中心之争背后的更大故事

summary.en: The US president's efforts to leave his mark on America's institutions are proving deeply divisive, with a federal judge ordering that the Trump administration cannot alter or demolish the Kennedy Center without at least 30 days' notice, following comments made by Trump about the building needing to be "ripped down".
summary.zh: 美国总统试图在美国的机构上留下自己的印记，这正变得极具争议。一位联邦法官下令，特朗普政府在至少提前30天通知的情况下，不得更改或拆除肯尼迪中心，此前特朗普曾发表过关于该建筑需要被“拆毁”的言论。

body.en:
The saga of the Kennedy Center continues as a United States federal judge has warned that the Trump administration cannot alter or demolish the storied performing arts centre without at least 30 days' notice.

Judge Christopher Copper issued the order after receiving a submission comprising comments made by Donald Trump this week that the historic Washington DC building would have to be "ripped down". He was later photographed looking at what appears to be a rendition of the centre being demolished.

The administration has been in a long-standing clash over the 1960's building , named in tribute to the assassinated president John F Kennedy. In December, a Trump-appointed board of trustees voted to add his name to the building, a move subsequently blocked by the courts.

"I think that the Trump administration should certainly have recognition. Because frankly, if we don't do that, it's going to close. It'll end up being ripped down," Trump told reporters on Thursday.

A threatened shutdown of the centre is now in place, with Matt Floca, the Kennedy Center's Trump-backed executive director, saying the building has been temporarily closed to assess safety risks in areas "exhibiting severe structural deterioration."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Democrat Joyce Beatty has responded by claiming in court filings the closure "is a recipe for defendants extending their shutdown forever and closing the Kennedy Center for the next two years — the very thing this court said they could not do without its permission."

Trump installed himself as chairman of the centre soon after taking office for the second time last year, ousting 18 board members appointed by former president Joe Biden and inserting his own allies to key positions.

The new board dissolved the centre's Social Impact Division and rolled back diversity-focused programming. Dozens of high-profile artists, productions, and long-running residency groups pulled out in protest. Ticket sales dropped to their lowest levels since the pandemic.

The Washington Post recently reported that the centre would only collect US$124 million ($174 million) of the US$220 million ($309 million) it had projected for the period between 1 October 2025 and 30 September 2026, leaving a "roughly $23 million deficit" after substantial spending cuts.

The building was damaged in a storm earlier this month, with a "roughly four-by-five foot" section of plaster falling from the ceiling in the Grand Foyer. It is reported to be in dire need of repairs.

body.zh: 肯尼迪中心的传奇仍在继续，美国联邦法官警告称，特朗普政府不得在至少提前 30 天通知的情况下改变或拆除这座著名的表演艺术中心。 法官克里斯托弗·科珀 (Christopher Copper) 在收到唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 本周发表的评论后发布了该命令，该评论称华盛顿特区的历史建筑必须“拆除”。后来他被拍到正在观看似乎是被拆除的中心的再现。 这座 1960 年代的建筑是为了纪念被暗杀的总统约翰·F·肯尼迪而命名的，政府之间一直存在长期冲突。去年12月，特朗普任命的董事会投票决定将他的名字添加到大楼中，但此举随后被法院阻止。 “我认为特朗普政府当然应该得到认可。因为坦率地说，如果我们不这样做，它就会关闭。它最终会被推倒，”特朗普周四告诉记者。 特朗普支持的肯尼迪中心执行董事马特·弗洛卡(Matt Floca)表示，该建筑已暂时关闭，以评估“结构严重恶化”地区的安全风险。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 民主党人乔伊斯·比蒂对此作出回应，在法庭文件中声称，关闭“是被告永久延长关闭时间并在未来两年关闭肯尼迪中心的良方——法院表示，未经其许可，他们不能这样做。” 特朗普去年第二次就任该中心主席后不久，就罢免了前总统乔·拜登任命的 18 名董事会成员，并让自己的盟友担任关键职位。 新董事会解散了该中心的社会影响部门，并取消了以多元化为重点的项目。数十名知名艺术家、作品和长期驻留团体退出以示抗议。门票销量跌至大流行以来的最低水平。 《华盛顿邮报》最近报道称，该中心预计在 2025 年 10 月 1 日至 2026 年 9 月 30 日期间筹集的资金为 2.2 亿美元（3.09 亿美元），而该中心将仅收取 1.24 亿美元（1.74 亿美元），在大幅削减支出后留下“约 2300 万美元的赤字”。 该建筑在本月早些时候的一场暴风雨中受损，大厅天花板上有一块“大约四乘五英尺”的灰泥掉落。据报道，该处急需维修。 六月，根据库珀法官的命令，工作人员将特朗普的名字从大楼外抹掉，该命令确认只有国会有权改变其...

reflection.en: The Kennedy Center, a national performing arts center, is caught in a political tug-of-war. President Trump's desire to reshape or even demolish it, as reported, raises questions about the stewardship of public institutions. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers...

title.en: ‘Forcing a reckoning’: How Asia is preparing for a ‘supersized’ El Niño
title.zh: 亚洲如何为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象做准备

summary.en: Governments across Asia are urgently preparing for the most severe El Niño event on record, anticipating widespread droughts, wildfires, typhoons, and floods. This extreme weather, exacerbated by human-driven climate change, is expected to bring multiple crises, including heat, heavy rain, and food shortages, to...
summary.zh: 亚洲各国政府正紧急为有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象做准备，预计将出现大范围的干旱、野火、台风和洪水。这种由人为气候变化加剧的极端天气，预计将从现在到2027年给数亿人带来包括高温、暴雨和粮食短缺在内的多重危机。

body.en: From Sri Lanka to South Korea, governments are preparing for droughts, wildfires, typhoons and floods – with climate plans facing their biggest challenge to date Asian governments are rushing preparations for the most severe El Niño weather event on record, with hundreds of millions of people bracing for multiple crises at once as extreme heat, heavy rain and food shortages hit the region. Fuelled by exceptionally warm ocean conditions across the tropical Pacific – and developing alongside the human-driven climate crisis – El Niño is virtually guaranteed to grow to a very strong intensity towards the end of this year and into 2027. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从斯里兰卡到韩国，各国政府正在为干旱、野火、台风和洪水做准备——气候计划面临迄今为止最大的挑战。亚洲各国政府正在加紧准备，应对有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺天气事件，随着极端高温、暴雨和粮食短缺袭击该地区，数亿人同时面临多重危机。在热带太平洋异常温暖的海洋条件的推动下，并与人类造成的气候危机一起发展，厄尔尼诺现象几乎肯定会在今年年底和 2027 年增长到非常强烈的强度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Asia braces for the impacts of a 'supersized' El Niño, the scale of potential devastation—droughts, wildfires, floods—underscores humanity's vulnerability to natural forces. In such times, the ancient words of Psalm 46:1 offer a profound reminder: 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' This truth offers solace and a call to...
reflection.zh: 随着亚洲为“巨型”厄尔尼诺现象的影响做准备，潜在破坏的规模——干旱、野火、洪水——凸显了人类在自然力量面前的脆弱性。在这样的时刻，诗篇46:1古老的言语提供了一个深刻的提醒：“雅伟是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是患难中随时的帮助。”这个真理在风暴聚集之时，为人们提供了慰藉，并呼唤人们寻求坚定不移的希望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

summary.en: The article criticizes the US government's approach to Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly the Republican stance favoring self-regulation by companies. It argues this is a dereliction of duty that increases AI risks. Prominent AI CEOs like Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Dario Amodei have called for a slowdown due...

body.en: Trump and Republicans want companies to regulate themselves. It’s a dereliction of duty that will make AI less safe It is hard to get Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Dario Amodei to agree on much. But over the weekend, all three AI company CEOs called for AI development to slow down in the face of growing, alarming risks. Their employees are sounding the siren too, with one researcher publicly quitting and accusing OpenAI and Anthropic of “gambling with our lives”. The combination of dire warnings from insiders and growing real-world evidence of rogue AIs should, in a sane world, lead to government action. Instead, Donald Trump and the Republican leadership have their heads in the sand. Continue reading...
body.zh: 特朗普和共和党人希望企业自我监管。失职会让人工智能变得不那么安全萨姆·奥尔特曼、埃隆·马斯克和达里奥·阿莫迪很难在很多方面达成一致。但上周末，三位人工智能公司首席执行官都呼吁，面对不断增长的令人震惊的风险，放慢人工智能的发展速度。他们的员工也拉响了警报，一名研究人员公开辞职，并指责 OpenAI 和 Anthropic “拿我们的生命进行赌博”。在一个理智的世界里，内部人士发出的可怕警告和现实世界中越来越多的流氓人工智能证据相结合，应该会导致政府采取行动。相反，唐纳德·特朗普和共和党领导层却把头埋在沙子里。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, as described in the article, presents a powerful new frontier. Like metals tested in a furnace, the leaders and companies driving this technology are being tested by its potential and the praise it garners. The calls for caution from within the industry itself suggest a recognition that unchecked progress can lead to unforeseen...
reflection.zh: 文章所描述的人工智能的快速发展，呈现了一个强大的新领域。正如金属在熔炉中被试炼一样，引领这项技术的领导者和公司正受到其潜力和所获赞誉的考验。行业内部发出的谨慎呼吁表明，人们认识到不受约束的进步可能导致无法预见的危险，这促使人们采取一种更审慎的方法，优先考虑安全和伦理考量。

title.en: An unexpected move by the US has sparked anger from China and Russia
title.zh: 美国出人意料的举动引发中俄愤怒

summary.en: Russia and China have expressed alarm at the revelation, warning against the idea of space becoming a "battlefield". The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a move that has sparked anger from China and Russia.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯和中国对这一消息表示震惊，警告太空可能成为“战场”。美国首次证实已在太空部署武器，此举引发了中国和俄罗斯的愤怒。

body.en:
The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In his remarks to the Air and Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference on Tuesday AEST, Meink also said the Air Force was adding more autonomous systems to its capabilities and predicted the service would look "radically different" by 2032.

For example, he foresaw one-way attack drones replacing artillery as the "primary killer".

Analysts said that the revelation by the US confirmed an open secret, but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with China and the risk of a weapons race in space.

In 2019, during his first term, US President Donal Trump created the Space Force as a separate military branch. In his second term, he has announced the Golden Dome missile defence system, which includes plans to put US weapons in space.

Trump said last year that he expected the system would be "fully operational before the end of my term", which ends in January 2029.

He said the system would have the capability of intercepting missiles "even if they are launched from space".

Trump also directed the Pentagon to pursue the space-based interceptors in an executive order during the first week of his presidency.

The Congressional Budget Office estimated that just the space-based components of the Golden Dome could cost as much as US$542 billion ($760 billion) over the next 20 years.

For the US, both Russia and China — its two main geopolitical rivals — pose potential threats to US interests in space.

China "develops and operates space and counterspace capabilities as part of a military modernisation strategy," according to the US Space Force.

Russia, meanwhile, "views space as a...
body.zh: 美国首次确认已在太空部署武器，这是在警告俄罗斯等国家可能将长期在条约中达成的仅用于和平目的的全球前沿武器化之后，这是一个引人注目的启示。 美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，美国已经部署了“能够保护联合部队免受敌对行动攻击的在轨太空控制武器”。 梅克没有详细说明这些武器是什么、它们如何工作，或者它们是否针对太空或地球上的其他物体。 美国两年前曾警告称，俄罗斯正在开发一种新的天基反卫星武器，尽管白宫当时表示危险并未迫在眉睫。 但有关反卫星武器的报道反映了人们长期以来对俄罗斯和中国太空威胁的担忧，因为美国的大部分基础设施都依赖于卫星通信。美国此前也展示了自己从地球击落卫星的能力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 梅克在澳大利亚东部标准时间周二举行的美国空军协会航空、航天和网络会议上发表讲话时还表示，空军正在为其能力添加更多自主系统，并预测到 2032 年该军种将“截然不同”。 例如，他预见单向攻击无人机将取代火炮成为“主要杀手”。 分析人士表示，美国的披露证实了一个公开的秘密，但公布的时机可能会加剧与中国的紧张关系以及太空武器竞赛的风险。 2019 年，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在其第一任期内创建了太空军，作为一个独立的军事部门。在他的第二个任期内，他宣布了金顶导弹防御系统，其中包括将美国武器部署到太空的计划。 特朗普去年表示，他预计该系统将“在我的任期结束前全面投入运行”，任期将于 2029 年 1 月结束。 他表示，该系统将具有拦截导弹的能力，“即使它们是从太空发射的”。 特朗普还在就任总统的第一周内发布行政命令，指示五角大楼追捕天基拦截器。 国会预算办公室估计，未来 20 年，仅金顶的太空部分就可能花费高达 5,420 亿美元（7,600 亿美元）。 对于美国来说，俄罗斯和中国这两个主要的地缘政治对手都对美国的太空利益构成潜在威胁。 美国太空军表示，中国“发展和运营太空和反太空能力，作为军事现代化战略的一部分”。 与此同时，俄罗斯“将太空视为......

reflection.en: The ancient prophetic vision of Isaiah, that nations would 'beat their swords into plowshares,' speaks to our deepest hopes for peace. Yet, the news of weapons being deployed in space, a frontier long envisioned for peaceful exploration, raises concerns about a new arms race. May wisdom guide nations to prioritize cooperation and shared stewardship of this...
reflection.zh: 以赛亚先知古老的预言，即列国将“把刀打成犁头”，触及我们对和平最深切的盼望。然而，太空这一曾被设想为和平探索之地的疆域，如今却传出部署武器的消息，这引发了对新军备竞赛的担忧。愿智慧引导列国，在广阔的太空疆域上，优先考虑合作与共同管理，而非冲突。

title.en: AI models chatting in ‘surreal’ dialect mixing poetic language and tech bro jargon

body.en: Experts air concern over AI lingo redolent of James Joyce’s prose that is creating barriers to monitoring and oversight AI models have begun communicating in a strange new version of English that reads like a cross between James Joyce’s Finnegans Wake and tech bro jargon, new research has found. Autonomous AI agents are rapidly creating novel dialects allowing them to converse in an often barely comprehensible language, which risks making it harder for humans to monitor their behaviour. Continue reading...
