They also mapped the precise locations of 955 of these tremors and discovered they were not randomly located. Instead, they lined up along two distinct, roughly parallel tracks stretching away from the test site.

One of these tracks followed the projected continuation of a fault line geologists already knew about. The second track revealed what appeared to be a completely hidden fault that had never been mapped before. The scientists concluded that the underground explosions had damaged the crust around pre-existing structural weaknesses. But what puzzled them was how explosions that ended years ago were still driving fault movements today.

To explain this long delay, the researchers ran computer models to see how the weight and shape of Mount Mantap affected stresses in the rock beneath it.

They found that the mountain itself played a major role, as its steep, heavy slopes put intense natural pressure on the rock directly beneath it. When the six nuclear explosions blasted through Mount Mantap, they damaged this already stressed rock and weakened the...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 2006年至2017年间，朝鲜在咸镜北道万塔山的大型试验场进行了六次地下核试验。通常情况下，地下爆炸会引发强烈的小地震，一旦测试停止，这些地震就会消失。但地质学家在最后一次爆炸后发现了更多的地震活动，并且这种活动已经持续了多年。 该地区此前被认为地质安静。一个多世纪以来，距该地点 50 公里（31 英里）范围内没有记录到发生过地壳地震。但一切在2017年发生了变化。 为了准确了解地下到底发生了什么，成都理工大学范兴丽领导的国际研究小组分析了2008年至2025年间记录的17年连续地震波数据。这些数据来自中国和韩国的区域监测站，距离80公里（50英里）至200公里（124英里）。 他们还使用了一种称为匹配滤波器检测的敏感模式匹配技术来发现标准地震监测网络通常会错过的较小的隐藏震动。 他们的研究结果发表在《科学》杂志上，挑战了长期以来关于地球在地下爆炸后如何反应的假设。 到 2025 年，万塔山附近的地震活动并没有像预期那样消失，而是稳步增加并加速。该团队总共检测到了 1,399 次当地小地震。研究作者写道：“在最终测试后的几年里，曼塔普山的地震活动持续增加。” 他们还绘制了 955 次地震的精确位置图，发现它们并不是随机定位的。相反，他们沿着两条截然不同的、大致平行的轨道排列，这些轨道从测试地点延伸出去。 其中一条轨迹是地质学家已知的断层线的预计延续。第二条轨迹揭示了一个似乎完全隐藏的断层，以前从未在地图上绘制过。科学家们得出的结论是，地下爆炸破坏了先前存在的结构弱点周围的地壳。但令他们困惑的是，多年前结束的爆炸如今为何仍在推动断层运动。 为了解释这种长时间的延迟，研究人员运行了计算机模型，以了解曼塔普山的重量和形状如何影响其下方岩石的应力。 他们发现山本身发挥了重要作用，因为其陡峭而沉重的斜坡对正下方的岩石施加了巨大的自然压力。当六次核爆炸穿过曼塔普山时，它们损坏了这块已经受压的岩石并削弱了......

reflection.en: The persistent tremors following North Korea's nuclear tests serve as a stark reminder of how destructive actions can have long-lasting, unforeseen consequences. This echoes the biblical call to actively overcome destructive forces, not by mirroring them, but by choosing a path of healing and restoration, even when the damage seems to linger.
reflection.zh: 朝鲜核试验后持续不断的震动，鲜明地提醒我们，破坏性行为会产生持久的、意想不到的后果。这呼应了圣经的呼召，要积极地克服破坏性的力量，不是以牙还牙，而是选择一条治愈和修复的道路，即使在破坏似乎仍然存在的时候。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Medieval Chinese skeleton may reveal first evidence of a brutal punishment
title.zh: 中世纪中国骸骨或揭示残酷刑罚的首次证据

summary.en: Archaeologists in China may have found the first skeletal evidence of a brutal punishment mentioned in historical texts: the removal of a person's nose. This discovery comes from a skeleton of a woman who lived approximately 700 years ago, a practice previously unconfirmed by skeletal remains.
summary.zh: 中国考古学家可能发现了历史文献中记载的一种残酷刑罚——割鼻——的首个骨骼证据。这一发现来自一具约700年前生活在中国的一名女性骸骨，此前骨骼遗骸尚未证实过这种做法。

body.en: Ancient Chinese authorities used many creative ways to punish people, often with methods designed to mark them for life. One brutal example mentioned repeatedly in historical texts is cutting off a person's nose. However, archaeologists in China have never found skeletal evidence to prove that it occurred. But that may have changed following the discovery of a skeleton of a woman who lived in China about 700 years ago.
body.zh: 中国古代当局使用了许多创造性的方式来惩罚人们，通常是为了给他们留下终身标记。历史文献中反复提到的一个残酷的例子就是割掉一个人的鼻子。然而，中国的考古学家从未找到骨骼证据来证明它曾经发生过。但随着一具大约 700 年前生活在中国的女性骨骼的发现，这种情况可能发生了变化。

reflection.en: The discovery of this skeleton offers a stark, tangible link to historical accounts of extreme punishment. It prompts reflection on the vulnerability of individuals within systems of power and the enduring need to advocate for those who suffer injustice. May we be moved to defend the oppressed and plead for the cause of the vulnerable, both in history and...
reflection.zh: 这具骸骨的发现，为我们提供了一个与古代严酷刑罚记载的鲜明、实在的联系。它促使我们反思权力体系下个体的脆弱性，以及为遭受不公者发声的持久需要。愿我们被激励去捍卫受压迫者，为弱势者的诉求辩护，无论是在历史上还是在今天。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Workplace AI adoption remains slow, informal and uneven, survey finds
title.zh: 调查发现：工作场所人工智能的采用仍然缓慢、非正式且不均衡

summary.en: A recent survey indicates that despite rapid advancements in generative AI and significant public interest, its integration into the daily work routines of most employees is not yet widespread. The Konstanz AI study, in its third wave, surveyed 1,105 employees in May 2026 and found that the percentage of employees...
summary.zh: 一项最新调查显示，尽管生成式人工智能发展迅速且公众兴趣浓厚，但其在大多数员工日常工作中的应用尚未普及。这是第三轮康斯坦茨人工智能研究的发现，该研究于2026年5月对1105名员工进行了调查，结果发现，与前一年相比，使用人工智能工作的员工比例仅从35%略微上升至38%。人工智能的采用通常是由员工驱动的，而不是组织战略的一...

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Despite the rapid development of generative AI and the high level of public interest, the use of AI in the day-to-day work of many employees is not yet the norm. This is the finding of the third wave of the Konstanz AI study , for which a total of 1,105 employees were surveyed in May 2026. The proportion of employees who use AI in their work rose only slightly from 35% to 38% compared with the previous year.

The data also show that the adoption of AI is frequently driven by employees rather than being strategically managed by organizations. Only 55% of AI users report that the AI tool they use most frequently was officially introduced by their employer. Many employees are thus acquiring hands-on experience with AI on their own initiative, while companies are often still catching up in terms of governance, secure infrastructure and workforce training.

"In many organizations, the major AI revolution has not unfolded as a planned transformation process so far," explains Florian Kunze, head of the study and professor of organizational behavior at the University of Konstanz. "Instead, many employees are experimenting with AI, while employers are still lagging behind when it comes to establishing clear policies, providing training and implementing secure AI solutions."

Disparities between different occupational groups continue to persist. In office and knowledge-based work, 49% of employees now use AI. Among employees in production-related and manual occupations, by contrast, the figure is only 25%. Despite year-on-year growth in both groups, the divide remains largely unchanged. This is likely due, at least in part, to the differing scope for AI applications in the respective fields of work.

Differences by educational attainment also remain pronounced. While 56% of employees with a high level of education use AI in their work, the figure is only 21% among employees with lower educational attainment. Employees with higher levels of education also express more positive expectations regarding the technology and speak more openly about its adoption.

Organizational size, too, plays a role. Small organizations are significantly less likely to offer AI training, establish formal guidelines for AI use or provide company-owned AI tools. For example, only 11% of employees in small organizations report having received AI training, and just 10% report having binding rules on the use of AI. In larger organizations, such support structures are much more common.

"The findings show that the AI transformation is unfolding unevenly across society," explains Elena Gerdiken, a doctoral...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 尽管生成式人工智能发展迅速且公众兴趣浓厚，但在许多员工的日常工作中使用人工智能尚未成为常态。这是康斯坦茨人工智能研究第三波的结果，该研究在 2026 年 5 月共调查了 1,105 名员工。与前一年相比，在工作中使用人工智能的员工比例仅略有上升，从 35% 上升至 38%。 数据还显示，人工智能的采用通常是由员工推动的，而不是由组织进行战略管理。只有 55% 的人工智能用户表示，他们最常使用的人工智能工具是由其雇主正式推出的。因此，许多员工主动获得人工智能的实践经验，而公司往往在治理、安全基础设施和劳动力培训方面仍在追赶。 该研究的负责人、康斯坦茨大学组织行为学教授弗洛里安·昆泽 (Florian Kunze) 解释说：“在许多组织中，重大的人工智能革命到目前为止还没有作为有计划的转型过程展开。” “相反，许多员工正在尝试人工智能，而雇主在制定明确的政策、提供培训和实施安全的人工智能解决方案方面仍然落后。” 不同职业群体之间的差异继续存在。在办公室和知识型工作中，49%的员工现在使用人工智能。相比之下，在生产相关和体力职业的员工中，这一数字仅为 25%。尽管两个群体均同比增长，但差距基本保持不变。这可能至少部分是由于人工智能在各个工作领域的应用范围不同。 受教育程度的差异也仍然很明显。高学历员工中有 56% 在工作中使用人工智能，而低学历员工中这一比例仅为 21%。受教育程度较高的员工也对该技术表达了更积极的期望，并更公开地谈论其采用。 组织规模也发挥着作用。小型组织提供人工智能培训、建立正式的人工智能使用指南或提供公司拥有的人工智能工具的可能性要小得多。例如，小型组织中只有 11% 的员工表示接受过人工智能培训，只有 10% 的员工表示制定了有关人工智能使用的约束性规则。在较大的组织中，这种支持结构更为常见。 博士埃琳娜·格迪肯 (Elena Gerdiken) 解释道：“研究结果表明，人工智能转型在整个社会的展开并不均衡。”

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of human knowledge and technological capability, as seen with AI, is a hallmark of our age. Daniel prophesied that 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' While this surge in knowledge can bring benefits, it also calls for discernment and wisdom, ensuring that these powerful tools serve humanity ethically and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，标志着人类知识和技术能力的飞速进步。但尼希米预言说，“许多人必往来奔跑，知识也必增长。” 尽管知识的激增能带来益处，但它也需要分辨力和智慧，确保这些强大的工具能够合乎道德地、建设性地服务于人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: To read 2,000-year-old burned scrolls, scientists burn their own
title.zh: 为了解读2000年前的烧毁卷轴，科学家们烧毁了自己的卷轴

summary.en: Douglas Seiler sourced materials from Egypt and Japan to recreate ancient writing methods. He then had students inscribe papyrus with texts from Star Wars, the Bible, and 'The Outer Limits.' Seiler then burned these papyrus scrolls in a furnace to replicate the conditions of ancient burned scrolls, aiming to...
summary.zh: 道格拉斯·西勒从埃及和日本采购了材料，以复制古代的书写方法。然后，他让学生在纸莎草上抄写了《星球大战》、圣经和《边疆禁地》的文本。随后，西勒将这些纸莎草卷轴放入炉子中焚烧，以复制古代烧毁卷轴的条件，旨在了解它们是如何被保存或解读的。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Douglas Seiler painstakingly sourced papyrus and reed pens from Egypt and traditional lampblack ink from Japan, then paid some high school students to inscribe the papyrus with lines from Star Wars and the Bible and a quote from the '60s sci-fi TV show The Outer Limits.

Seiler, an affiliate of Berkeley SETI, then rolled up the papyrus, placed it in a container inside a high-temperature furnace and burned it to a crisp.

The procedure replicated what happened to more than a thousand papyrus scrolls in a library in the Italian city of Herculaneum, when ash from Mount Vesuvius inundated the city in A.D. 79 and turned ancient learning—some likely unknown today—into brittle, carbonized husks. The eruption, which also buried nearby Pompeii, preserved for posterity the only known intact library from antiquity.

Seiler's goal was to determine whether it's possible to read the text on carbonized scrolls without unrolling them and reducing them to black dust. The key, he hypothesized, was that inks containing lead would stand out when a scroll is scanned by an X-ray beam and that computer algorithms could virtually unroll the scroll to reveal the hidden text.

In a paper published Sept. 16 in the journal PLOS ONE , Seiler and his collaborators, including several Berkeley experts, report that even minuscule amounts of lead in the ink make the letters readable by X-ray tomography, or X-ray CT. The lead absorbs up to 25 times as many X-rays as the charred papyrus, making the inked letters stand out.

"With lead in the ink, you would get a huge friggin' signature, so you really need to be looking for scrolls with lead in them," Seiler said. "They're having problems reading a lot of them because of the low contrast of carbon ink on carbon paper. We're relatively certain that if they start searching for lead, or they let us search for lead, it will help this whole process. This is the Holy Grail."

In the paper, the researchers also showed that an inexpensive handheld X-ray fluorescence scanner can easily detect leaded ink in a burned scroll, providing a simple way to identify scrolls that would be more easily deciphered using X-ray CT.

To date, only a few charred scrolls from the Villa of the Papyri at Herculaneum have been virtually unrolled and read, and none were tested for leaded ink. Though no one has systematically looked for leaded ink in the scrolls, at least one researcher found lead in the ink of a fragment that remained from earlier efforts to physically unroll some of them. Most of those attempts followed the scrolls' discovery in 1752, but when unrolling mostly produced...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 道格拉斯·塞勒 (Douglas Seiler) 煞费苦心地从埃及采购了纸莎草和芦苇笔，从日本采购了传统的油烟墨水，然后付钱给一些高中生，让他们在纸莎草上刻上《星球大战》和《圣经》中的台词以及 60 年代科幻电视节目《外部极限》中的台词。 伯克利SETI的附属机构塞勒随后将纸莎草纸卷起来，放入高温炉内的容器中，并将其烧成脆饼。 这一过程复制了意大利赫库兰尼姆市图书馆中一千多卷纸莎草卷轴的情况，当时维苏威火山的火山灰在公元 79 年淹没了这座城市，将古老的知识（有些今天可能不为人知）变成了易碎的碳化外壳。这次火山喷发还掩埋了附近的庞贝古城，为后人保留了唯一已知完整的古代图书馆。 塞勒的目标是确定是否可以在不展开碳化卷轴并将其变成黑色灰尘的情况下阅读碳化卷轴上的文字。他推测，关键在于，当 X 射线扫描卷轴时，含铅墨水会脱颖而出，并且计算机算法实际上可以展开卷轴以显示隐藏的文本。 在 9 月 16 日发表在《PLOS ONE》杂志上的一篇论文中，塞勒和他的合作者（包括几位伯克利大学的专家）报告说，即使墨水中含有微量的铅，也可以通过 X 射线断层扫描或 X 射线 CT 读取这些字母。铅吸收的 X 射线量是烧焦的纸莎草的 25 倍，使得墨迹字母脱颖而出。 “墨水中含有铅，你会得到一个巨大的签名，所以你真的需要寻找含有铅的卷轴，”塞勒说。 “由于复写纸上的碳墨水对比度较低，他们在阅读很多内容时遇到了问题。我们相对确定，如果他们开始寻找铅，或者他们让我们寻找铅，这将有助于整个过程。这就是圣杯。” 在论文中，研究人员还表明，一种廉价的手持式 X 射线荧光扫描仪可以轻松检测烧毁的卷轴中的含铅墨水，从而提供了一种简单的方法来识别卷轴，并且使用 X 射线 CT 更容易破译。 迄今为止，赫库兰尼姆纸莎草别墅中只有几卷烧焦的卷轴被实际展开和阅读，并且没有经过含铅墨水测试。尽管没有人系统地寻找卷轴中的含铅墨水，但至少一名研究人员在早期物理展开其中一些卷轴的努力中留下的碎片的墨水中发现了铅。大多数这些尝试都是在 1752 年发现卷轴之后进行的，但是当卷轴展开时，大部分产生了……

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge often requires us to step into the unknown, sometimes even replicating destructive processes to understand them. This scientific endeavor, burning scrolls to save them, echoes the ancient wisdom found in Job, which encourages us to learn from the natural world and the lessons it holds. It reminds us that understanding often comes...
reflection.zh: 追求知识常常需要我们踏入未知，有时甚至需要复制破坏性的过程来理解它们。这种科学探索，通过焚烧卷轴来试图保存它们，呼应了《约伯记》中发现的古老智慧，鼓励我们从自然界及其所蕴含的教训中学习。它提醒我们，理解往往来自于勤奋的探究和面对艰难现实的意愿。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Power breeds suspicion: In cases of wrongdoing, people point to leaders more quickly
title.zh: 权力滋生猜疑：犯错时，人们更快地指向领导者

summary.en: Research from the University of Amsterdam indicates that individuals in positions of power are more readily blamed when mistakes occur and the culprit is unknown. This tendency stems from a perception that powerful people can 'get away with anything.' The findings are based on an analysis of nearly 100,000 conflicts...
summary.zh: 阿姆斯特丹大学的研究表明，当发生错误且罪魁祸首不明时，有权力的人更容易被指责。这种倾向源于一种看法，即有权势的人可以“为所欲为”。这些发现基于对Reddit论坛“我是混蛋吗？”上近十万起冲突的分析。

body.en: People with power are more quickly singled out as the culprit when something goes wrong but it is unclear who made the mistake. That is shown by a series of studies by researchers at the University of Amsterdam. In one, they analyzed almost 100,000 everyday conflicts on the Reddit page "Am I the Asshole?" According to the researchers, people with power are more readily blamed because others think they can "get away with anything." The findings are published in the Journal of Personality and Social Psychology.
body.zh: 当出现问题时，有权势的人会更快地被认定为罪魁祸首，但不清楚是谁犯了错误。阿姆斯特丹大学研究人员的一系列研究表明了这一点。其中，他们分析了 Reddit 页面“我是混蛋吗？”上近 100,000 起日常冲突。研究人员表示，有权势的人更容易受到指责，因为其他人认为他们可以“做任何事情而不受惩罚”。研究结果发表在《人格与社会心理学杂志》上。

reflection.en: This research points to a deep human instinct: when things go wrong, we look to those in charge. The Bible speaks to this expectation, reminding us that true leadership is not about avoiding blame, but about actively pursuing justice and showing compassion. Leaders, like all people, are called to act justly and love mercy, reflecting a higher standard of...
reflection.zh: 这项研究指出了人类的一种深刻本能：当事情出错时，我们会看向掌权者。圣经谈到了这种期望，提醒我们真正的领导力不在于逃避指责，而在于积极追求公义和显出怜悯。领导者，如同所有人一样，被呼召要秉公行义，喜爱怜悯，这反映了更高的问责标准。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Tech billionaires trying to live for ever? That’s a waste of time, says physicist
title.zh: 科技巨头想长生不老？物理学家称是浪费时间

summary.en: Physicist Prof. Jim Al-Khalili has stated that tech billionaires attempting to achieve immortality are wasting their time. He plans to discuss solutions to the 'arrow of time' problem in his upcoming lectures. The article mentions Bryan Johnson's attempt to inject plasma from his son for anti-aging purposes, which he...
summary.zh: 物理学家吉姆·阿尔-哈利利教授表示，那些试图永生的科技巨头是在浪费时间。他将在接下来的讲座中探讨“时间之箭”问题的解决方案。文章提到布莱恩·约翰逊曾尝试注射他17岁儿子的血浆以抗衰老，但后来发现无效。

body.en: Exclusive: Prof Jim Al-Khalili says he will offer solution to ‘arrow of time’ problem in Royal Institution lectures Tech billionaires attempting to live for ever are, quite literally, wasting their time, a leading physicist has said. While some normal people are turning to unregulated peptide injections , cold plunges and supplements in an effort to defy ageing, the ultra-rich are aiming for immortality with even more drastic interventions: the tech chief executive Bryan Johnson has even tried injecting plasma from his 17-year-old son – although he later said he saw no benefit from it. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：吉姆·哈利利教授表示，他将在皇家学院的讲座中提供“时间之箭”问题的解决方案一位著名物理学家表示，试图永生的科技亿万富翁实际上是在浪费时间。虽然一些普通人正在转向不受监管的肽注射、冷饮和补充剂来抗衰老，但超级富豪却以更激烈的干预措施来实现永生：科技公司首席执行官布莱恩·约翰逊甚至尝试注射他 17 岁儿子的血浆——尽管他后来表示，他认为这没有任何好处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of immortality by some of the wealthiest individuals highlights a deep human struggle with our finite existence. Yet, as physicist Jim Al-Khalili suggests, this pursuit may be a distraction from the fundamental reality of our mortality. The ancient wisdom of Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a fixed point in human life, a truth...
reflection.zh: 一些最富有的人对永生的不懈追求，凸显了人类面对有限存在的深刻挣扎。然而，正如物理学家吉姆·阿尔-哈利利所言，这种追求可能分散了我们对生命终将逝去的根本现实的注意力。希伯来书9:27中的古老智慧提醒我们，死亡是人类生命中一个确定的节点，这一事实可以让我们珍惜当下拥有的时光。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Scientists discover cells that cheat death and rebuild damaged tissue
title.zh: 科学家发现能“欺骗”死亡并重建受损组织的细胞

summary.en: Scientists have identified a type of cell that can initiate programmed cell death, survive it, and then facilitate rapid rebuilding of damaged tissue. These cells become more resistant to future damage, offering potential improvements for healing but also raising concerns about cancer recurrence.
summary.zh: 科学家们发现了一类细胞，它们能够启动程序性细胞死亡，并在存活后迅速重建受损组织。这些细胞对未来损伤的抵抗力会增强，这可能有助于改善愈合过程，但也可能引发癌症复发的担忧。

body.en:
Scientists uncover a cellular survival mechanism that helps severely damaged tissue regenerate and may also reveal why some cancers return after treatment.

Tissues such as skin, along with the epithelial layers that cover and line many organs, have a remarkable ability to rebuild themselves after extensive damage. Scientists have known about this response, called compensatory proliferation, for roughly half a century. Yet exactly how cells manage to trigger such dramatic regrowth has remained a mystery.

The phenomenon was first documented in the 1970s, when researchers exposed fly larvae to high doses of radiation. Despite major damage to epithelial tissue, the larvae were able to regenerate fully functional wings. Similar regenerative responses have since been observed across many species, including humans.

Now, researchers at the Weizmann Institute of Science say they have identified a molecular mechanism that helps explain how this process works. Their study, published in Nature Communications , points to a surprising role for caspases, enzymes best known for helping destroy cells.

Instead of simply promoting cell death, caspases can apparently help certain cells become resistant to death. Those survivors can then participate in rebuilding damaged tissue and may even become better equipped to withstand future injury. The same ability, however, could have a dangerous downside. Cancer cells may exploit this survival mechanism, potentially contributing to tumors that return in a more aggressive and treatment-resistant form.

The discovery could eventually help researchers develop approaches that encourage healthy tissue repair while also reducing the risk of cancer recurrence.

One of the main ways the body eliminates unwanted cells is through apoptosis, a carefully controlled form of cellular "suicide." Cells can enter apoptosis when they become old, damaged, or receive molecular signals telling them that their time is up.

The process involves several caspase enzymes. An initiator caspase first activates the pathway, followed by effector caspases that break apart proteins inside the doomed cell.

During the past two decades, however, researchers have discovered that apoptotic caspases are not limited to killing cells. Work by scientists around the world, including the laboratory of Prof. Eli Arama in Weizmann's Molecular Genetics Department, has shown that these enzymes can also participate in biological processes that are essential for life.

Arama, an early researcher of these nonlethal caspase functions, suspected that they might also help drive compensatory proliferation.

To investigate, a team led by Dr. Tslil Braun from Arama's lab recreated the classic experiment that originally revealed compensatory proliferation. The researchers...
body.zh: 科学家发现了一种细胞生存机制，可以帮助严重受损的组织再生，也可能揭示为什么某些癌症在治疗后会复发。 皮肤等组织以及覆盖和排列许多器官的上皮层在严重损伤后具有非凡的自我重建能力。大约半个世纪以来，科学家们就知道这种称为补偿性增殖的反应。然而，细胞究竟是如何引发如此戏剧性的再生仍然是一个谜。 这种现象首次被记录在 20 世纪 70 年代，当时研究人员将苍蝇幼虫暴露在高剂量的辐射下。尽管上皮组织受到严重损害，幼虫仍能够再生出功能齐全的翅膀。此后，在包括人类在内的许多物种中都观察到了类似的再生反应。 现在，魏茨曼科学研究所的研究人员表示，他们已经确定了一种分子机制，有助于解释这一过程是如何运作的。他们的研究发表在《自然通讯》上，指出了半胱天冬酶的惊人作用，半胱天冬酶是一种以帮助破坏细胞而闻名的酶。 半胱天冬酶显然可以帮助某些细胞抵抗死亡，而不是简单地促进细胞死亡。然后，这些幸存者可以参与重建受损组织，甚至可能变得更好，以承受未来的伤害。然而，同样的能力可能有一个危险的缺点。癌细胞可能会利用这种生存机制，从而可能导致肿瘤以更具侵袭性和耐药性的形式复发。 这一发现最终可以帮助研究人员开发出鼓励健康组织修复同时降低癌症复发风险的方法。 身体消除不需要的细胞的主要方式之一是通过细胞凋亡，这是一种精心控制的细胞“自杀”形式。当细胞变老、受损或收到分子信号告诉它们生命已到时，它们就会进入凋亡状态。 该过程涉及几种半胱天冬酶。起始半胱天冬酶首先激活该通路，随后是效应半胱天冬酶，其分解注定细胞内的蛋白质。 然而，在过去的二十年中，研究人员发现凋亡半胱天冬酶不仅限于杀死细胞。包括魏茨曼分子遗传学系 Eli Arama 教授实验室在内的世界各地科学家的工作表明，这些酶还可以参与生命所必需的生物过程。 Arama 是这些非致命性半胱天冬酶功能的早期研究者，他怀疑它们也可能有助于驱动代偿性增殖。 为了进行调查，Arama 实验室的 Tslil Braun 博士领导的团队重新创建了最初揭示代偿性增殖的经典实验。研究人员...

reflection.en: The discovery of cells that can seemingly cheat death to rebuild damaged tissue is a testament to the intricate wisdom embedded in Yahweh's creation. It reminds us that even in biological processes that appear to involve 'death,' there is a profound capacity for renewal and resilience, reflecting a deeper order we are still uncovering.
reflection.zh: 发现能够“欺骗”死亡并重建受损组织的细胞，是造物主雅伟所创造的精妙智慧的明证。它提醒我们，即使在看似涉及“死亡”的生物过程中，也蕴含着深刻的更新和韧性，这反映了我们仍在探索的更深层秩序。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists just named a new snake after Guns N’ Roses legend Slash
title.zh: 科学家以枪炮与玫瑰传奇人物斯莱什的名字命名了一种新蛇

summary.en: A new snake species discovered in New Guinea has been named Lielaphis slashi, or Slash's groundsnake, after Guns N' Roses guitarist Slash, who has a lifelong fascination with reptiles and has supported natural history institutions. Genetic testing and physical differences confirmed it as a previously unknown species.
summary.zh: 一种在新几内亚发现的新蛇被命名为Lielaphis slashi，或称斯莱什地蛇，以致敬枪炮与玫瑰乐队吉他手斯莱什，他对爬行动物有着毕生的兴趣，并一直支持自然历史机构。基因检测和物理差异证实了它是一个此前未知的物种。

body.en:
Slash, also known as Saul Hudson, is famous worldwide as the guitarist for Guns N' Roses. But music is only part of his story. He has also been fascinated by reptiles for most of his life and has long supported zoos, museums, and natural history.

Now that passion has earned him an unusual scientific honor. Researchers have named a newly identified snake species from New Guinea Lielaphis slashi , or Slash's groundsnake.

"As a long time herpephile, I am extremely honored and humbled to have Lielaphis slashi from New Guinea named after me. It is really exciting, I never would have imagined this moment would arrive," says Slash.

For Sara Ruane, the Field Museum's Associate Curator of Herpetology and senior author of a paper in Zootaxa describing the species, the name also has a personal connection.

"Guns N' Roses has been one of my favorite bands since I was in first grade, and by fifth grade, I had already told my teacher that I wanted to be a herpetologist -- a scientist who studies reptiles -- when I grew up," says Sara Ruane, the Field Museum's Associate Curator of Herpetology and senior author of a paper in Zootaxa describing the new species. "So when I was twelve years old and got my copy of Reptiles Magazine in the mail and it had a picture of Slash holding his pet reticulated python on the cover, I thought, 'This guy is so cool.'"

Years later, after Ruane became a scientist who sometimes has the opportunity to assign official names to newly recognized reptile species, she returned to that old magazine interview.

"I reread his interview, and he talked about how much he loves museums and zoos and natural history, and about how when he was a kid, he'd go outside and look for snakes -- it was all stuff that I really related to, and it made me think that he'd be a great person to name a new species after," says Ruane.

Her opportunity eventually came in the form of a reddish-brown snake measuring 28 inches long that had been collected in the forests of New Guinea.

New Guinea is the world's second-largest island, behind Greenland. Located just north of Australia, the island is divided between Indonesia and Papua New Guinea. Its tropical forests support enormous biological diversity, much of which remains poorly documented by scientists.

During fieldwork one night in 2006, Chris Austin, a professor and curator of herpetology at the Louisiana State University Museum of Natural Science, encountered a snake in New Guinea that he did not recognize.

"These New Guinea groundsnakes are nocturnal, so the best way to find them is at night. They are typically found just after sunset at the base of large trees where they are looking for something to eat," says Austin, a co-author of the paper describing the new species. "When working at night in New...
body.zh: Slash，又名 Saul Hudson，作为 Guns N' Roses 乐队的吉他手而闻名于世。但音乐只是他故事的一部分。他一生的大部分时间都对爬行动物着迷，并长期支持动物园、博物馆和自然历史。 现在，这种热情为他赢得了不同寻常的科学荣誉。研究人员将一种新发现的来自新几内亚的蛇种命名为 Lielaphislashi 或 Slash 地蛇。 “作为一名长期的疱疹病毒感染者，我感到非常荣幸和谦卑，来自新几内亚的 Lielaphislashi 以我的名字命名。这真的很令人兴奋，我从来没有想到这一刻会到来，”Slash 说。 对于菲尔德博物馆爬行动物学副馆长、Zootaxa 上描述该物种的论文的资深作者萨拉·鲁恩 (Sara Ruane) 来说，这个名字也有着个人联系。 “从我一年级起，枪与玫瑰乐队就一直是我最喜欢的乐队之一，到五年级时，我已经告诉老师，我长大后想成为一名爬行动物学家——一名研究爬行动物的科学家，”菲尔德博物馆爬行动物学副馆长、《Zootaxa》上一篇描述新物种的论文的资深作者萨拉·鲁恩 (Sara Ruane) 说道。 “所以当我十二岁的时候，我收到了一份《爬行动物杂志》，封面上有一张斯莱什抱着他的宠物网纹蟒的照片，我想，‘这家伙太酷了。’” 多年后，当鲁安成为一名科学家，有时有机会为新认识的爬行动物物种指定正式名称后，她又回到了旧杂志的采访中。 “我重读了他的采访，他谈到了他多么喜欢博物馆、动物园和自然历史，以及他小时候如何出去寻找蛇——这些都是我真正感兴趣的东西，这让我觉得他会是一个伟大的人，可以用他的名字来命名一个新物种，”鲁恩说。 她的机会最终出现在一条 28 英寸长的红棕色蛇身上，这条蛇是在新几内亚的森林里采集到的。 新几内亚是世界第二大岛屿，仅次于格陵兰岛。该岛位于澳大利亚北部，分为印度尼西亚和巴布亚新几内亚。它的热带森林孕育着巨大的生物多样性，但科学家对其中大部分的记录仍然很少。 2006 年的一个晚上，路易斯安那州立大学自然科学博物馆爬行动物学教授兼馆长克里斯·奥斯汀 (Chris Austin) 在进行实地考察时，在新几内亚遇到了一条他不认识的蛇。 “这些新几内亚地蛇是夜间活动的，所以找到它们的最好方法是在晚上。它们通常在日落后被发现在大树下寻找食物，”描述该新物种的论文的合著者奥斯汀说。 “晚上在新城工作时...

reflection.en: The discovery of Lielaphis slashi, a new groundsnake species named after guitarist Slash, reminds us of the incredible diversity Yahweh has woven into the fabric of creation. Even in remote New Guinea, new wonders await discovery, reflecting the boundless creativity and intricate design of the Creator. This naming honors a passion for the natural world, a...
reflection.zh: 新发现的斯莱什地蛇Lielaphis slashi，以吉他手斯莱什的名字命名，提醒我们雅伟已将令人难以置信的多样性编织进创造的肌理中。即使在新几内亚的偏远地区，新的奇迹也在等待被发现，这反映了创造者无限的创造力和精妙的设计。...

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Michael Sheen's 'constructive' meeting with first minister over toxic dumping claims
title.zh: 迈克尔·辛的“建设性”会议，涉及有毒倾倒指控

summary.en: Hollywood actor Michael Sheen stated that his meeting with the First Minister was "early days but that's really encouraging" regarding toxic dumping claims featured in his BBC documentary. The documentary, "Buried with Michael Sheen," investigates 14 sites in Wales and England suspected of toxic chemical dumping....
summary.zh: 好莱坞演员迈克尔·辛表示，他与第一部长就其BBC纪录片中提出的有毒倾倒指控进行的会议“尚处早期，但这确实令人鼓舞”。纪录片《迈克尔·辛的埋藏》调查了威尔士和英格兰的14个疑似有毒化学品倾倒地点。辛此前曾指出，在纪录片播出前，第一部长的办公室最初并未作出回应，但在他们最近就如何推进问题进行讨论后，他表示乐观。

body.en:
Hollywood actor Michael Sheen said he had a "constructive" meeting with First Minister Rhun ap Iorwerth over toxic dumping claims raised in his BBC documentary.

Buried with Michael Sheen explores toxic chemical dumping in 14 sites in Wales and England.

Sheen initially said an offer to meet the first minister "was not taken up" before the documentary was broadcast in August.

On Thursday, the Welsh actor said he met the first minister, speaking about how they could move forward adding it was "early days but that's really encouraging".

Speaking on Instagram , external , he said "I've just come from a meeting with the first minister.

"Talking about how we can move forward and address all the issues that Buried [the documentary] raised around the toxic dumping, and that was really constructive.

In the UK Parliament last week, Sheen urged MPs to back a national testing programme for historic toxic dumps to make sure sites were safe, after high levels of cancer-causing chemicals - known as PCBs - were found in soil samples and in the blood of people living near sites linked to chemical giant Monsanto.

Sheen interviewed farming consultant turned campaigner Douglas Gowan shortly before his death, who had spent decades warning that communities were at risk of toxic chemicals.

The actor later teamed up with investigative journalists Lucy Taylor and Dan Ashby who had inherited all of the campaigner's documents and research.

They set about testing 14 sites in Wales and north west England where it was thought Monsanto had been dumping PCBs, and found elevated levels at all but one.

Susan Smith, who worked at Monsanto in Wrexham, said her happy memories of working there have been replaced with fears following the documentary.

Susan and her husband Geraint's home, which they have lived in for 53 years, is separated from the decommissioned Ruabon chemical works by a thin tree line.

Geraint was diagnosed with prostate cancer 13 years ago before more recently developing skin cancer, while Susan developed breast cancer when she was 38.

While they admit they are not certain that Monsanto was responsible, the documentary has made them question the possible impact of the factory on their family's health.

Susan worked as a secretary for four years when she was 19, then returned once for temporary cover and another time to overhaul a failing system.

"Most of my time was spent in the telex office next to the warehouse. We used to send delivery notes, instructions, requests on little pieces of ticker tape through a machine to other Monsanto offices," she said.

"We had a small glass hatch that the instructions would be passed through and it was never closed because people were passing things through so often. As a result dust and powders and all sorts would...
body.zh: 好莱坞演员迈克尔·辛 (Michael Sheen) 表示，他与首席部长 Rhun ap Iorwerth 就 BBC 纪录片中提出的有毒倾倒指控进行了“建设性”会面。 迈克尔·辛 (Michael Sheen) 与埋葬者一起探索威尔士和英格兰 14 个地点的有毒化学品倾倒情况。 辛最初表示，在这部纪录片于八月播出之前，与首席部长会面的提议“没有被接受”。 周四，这位威尔士演员表示，他会见了首席部长，谈到了他们如何向前迈进，并补充说“现在还为时过早，但这确实令人鼓舞”。 他在 Instagram 上对外表示：“我刚刚与首席部长开完会。 “谈论我们如何前进并解决埋藏[纪录片]围绕有毒倾倒问题提出的所有问题，这确实具有建设性。 上周在英国议会，在化学巨头孟山都公司相关地点附近的土壤样本和人们的血液中发现了高含量的致癌化学物质（称为多氯联苯）后，希恩敦促国会议员支持一项针对历史性有毒物质倾倒场的国家测试计划，以确保场地安全。 辛在去世前不久采访了农业顾问、后来成为活动家的道格拉斯·高恩(Douglas Gowan)，他几十年来一直警告社区面临有毒化学品的风险。 这位演员后来与调查记者露西·泰勒和丹·阿什比合作，他们继承了这位活动家的所有文件和研究。 他们开始对威尔士和英格兰西北部的 14 个地点进行测试，据信孟山都曾在这些地点倾倒多氯联苯，结果发现，除了一处之外，其他地点的含量均有所升高。 在雷克瑟姆的孟山都公司工作的苏珊·史密斯表示，这部纪录片之后，她在那里工作的快乐记忆已经被恐惧所取代。 苏珊和她丈夫杰兰特的家已经居住了 53 年，与已退役的鲁邦化工厂仅隔着一条细细的树线。 Geraint 13 年前被诊断出患有前列腺癌，最近又患上了皮肤癌，而 Susan 在 38 岁时患上了乳腺癌。 虽然他们承认不确定孟山都是否对此负责，但这部纪录片让他们质疑该工厂对他们家人的健康可能产生的影响。 苏珊 19 岁时担任了四年的秘书，然后回来一次是为了临时工作，另一次是为了彻底改革一个失败的系统。 “我的大部分时间都花在仓库旁边的电报办公室里。我们过去常常通过机器向孟山都的其他办事处发送送货单、指示和小纸条上的请求，”她说。 “我们有一个小玻璃舱口，指令可以通过它，但它永远不会关闭，因为人们经常传递东西。因此，灰尘和粉末以及各种各样的东西会......

reflection.en: The pursuit of truth and justice often requires persistent advocacy. Michael Sheen's documentary brought attention to toxic dumping sites, and his subsequent engagement with the First Minister demonstrates a commitment to speaking for those who may be harmed and for the environment itself. This echoes the call to 'open your mouth for the speechless, in the...
reflection.zh: 追求真理和正义往往需要不懈的倡导。迈克尔·辛的纪录片揭露了有毒倾倒地点，随后他与第一部长的接触，展现了他为可能受害者和环境发声的决心。这呼应了‘你要开口为贫寒的、为一切将亡的人辩屈’的教导，敦促我们为弱势群体发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope could last more than twice as long as planned
title.zh: NASA的罗马空间望远镜使用寿命可能超过计划的两倍

summary.en: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is now projected to have enough fuel for at least 22 years of scientific operations, more than double its initial 10-year design life. This extended capability is attributed to precise course corrections, extra fuel at launch, and anticipated savings, allowing the observatory...
summary.zh: 美国国家航空航天局的南希·格蕾丝·罗马空间望远镜目前预计有足够的燃料进行至少22年的科学运行，是其最初10年设计寿命的两倍多。这种能力的延长归功于精确的轨道修正、发射时的额外燃料以及预期的节省，使该天文台能够继续其对宇宙的研究。

body.en:
NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope may be able to operate for far longer than originally expected. An exceptionally precise first mid-course correction, combined with other fuel savings, could more than double the observatory's potential lifetime in space.

"As a result of exquisite planning by our orbital dynamics team, brilliant execution by the operations team, and a precise launch from SpaceX, Roman has fuel for at least 22 years of potential science operations," said Jamie Dunn, center director at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland.

Several factors are behind that dramatic extension. Roman used far less fuel than expected during its first course correction, carried additional propellant at launch, and is projected to conserve even more during its second mid-course correction and orbital insertion.

Roman was built around a five-year primary mission and a five-year extended mission, giving it a total fuel budget intended to support 10 years of operations. Because propellant is the spacecraft's main consumable resource, every kilogram saved during its journey can potentially translate into additional years of scientific observations.

Roman carried out its first burn on Aug. 31, adjusting its path toward the observatory's eventual orbit. Since then, the mission team has been studying how the maneuver affected Roman's long-term fuel outlook.

The results were better than expected. The maneuver was completed with more than 99% accuracy and consumed less than 10% of the fuel reserved for it. Roman used about 40 pounds (18 kilograms), compared with the planned allocation of 441 pounds (200 kilograms).

Those savings alone could provide roughly four additional years of potential science operations.

Roman also began its journey with more propellant available than planners originally expected to need.

Engineers calculated the spacecraft's fuel requirements using a conservative maximum weight of 21,605 pounds (9,800 kilograms). Roman ultimately weighed just 17,760 pounds (8,056 kilograms) at launch.

Because the spacecraft was lighter, it required less fuel for its mid-course correction. Its lower mass also allowed the team to fill Roman's propellant tanks to capacity rather than carrying only enough fuel for the original 10-year mission.

"A spacecraft's mass changes throughout the design and build process, so we base the propellant budget on a set maximum value so we won't come up short," said Alison Rao, the Roman propulsion lead at NASA Goddard. "We track the propellant needed based on actual mass throughout integration and testing as well, to make sure we have wiggle room. Since Roman's was lower than we budgeted for, we were able to fill the propellant tanks to their capacity rather than only filling them as much as...
body.zh: 美国宇航局的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜的运行时间可能比最初预期的要长得多。极其精确的第一次中途修正，再加上其他燃料节省，可以使天文台的潜在太空寿命延长一倍以上。 位于马里兰州格林贝尔特的 NASA 戈达德太空飞行中心中心主任杰米·邓恩 (Jamie Dunn) 表示：“由于我们轨道动力学团队的精心规划、运营团队的出色执行以及 SpaceX 的精确发射，罗曼拥有至少 22 年潜在科学运营所需的燃料。” 这种戏剧性的扩张背后有几个因素。罗马号在第一次航向修正期间使用的燃料远少于预期，在发射时携带了额外的推进剂，预计在第二次中途修正和入轨期间将节省更多燃料。 “罗马”号是围绕五年主要任务和五年扩展任务建造的，其总燃料预算旨在支持 10 年的运行。由于推进剂是航天器的主要消耗资源，因此在其旅程中节省的每一公斤都可能转化为额外多年的科学观测。 罗曼于 8 月 31 日进行了第一次燃烧，调整了其轨道以适应天文台的最终轨道。从那时起，任务团队一直在研究这一举措如何影响罗曼的长期燃料前景。 结果好于预期。此次演习的准确率超过 99%，且消耗的燃油不足 10%。罗曼使用了约 40 磅（18 公斤），而计划分配的重量为 441 磅（200 公斤）。 仅这些节省就可以提供大约四年的潜在科学运作。 罗马号开始其旅程时，可用的推进剂也比规划者最初预期需要的要多。 工程师使用保守的最大重量 21,605 磅（9,800 公斤）计算了航天器的燃料需求。罗曼最终在发射时的重量仅为 17,760 磅（8,056 公斤）。 由于航天器更轻，因此中途修正所需的燃料更少。其较低的质量也使得团队能够将罗马的推进剂罐装满，而不是只携带足够最初 10 年任务所需的燃料。 “航天器的质量在整个设计和建造过程中都会发生变化，因此我们将推进剂预算建立在设定的最大值上，这样我们就不会出现短缺，”美国宇航局戈达德太空中心的罗马推进负责人艾莉森·拉奥（Alison Rao）说。 “我们还根据整个集成和测试过程中的实际质量来跟踪所需的推进剂，以确保我们有回旋余地。由于罗马的推进剂低于我们的预算，我们能够将推进剂罐填充到其容量，而不是只填充...

reflection.en: The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh, and the vastness of the cosmos continues to unfold before us. The extended mission of the Roman Space Telescope promises more opportunities to witness this grandeur, reminding us of the immense scale of creation and the One who orchestrates it all. May these new discoveries inspire wonder and a deeper appreciation...
reflection.zh: 诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，宇宙的浩瀚在我们面前不断展开。罗马空间望远镜的延期任务预示着更多见证这份宏伟的机会，提醒我们造物的浩大规模以及那安排这一切的造物主。愿这些新发现激发惊叹，并对宇宙精妙的设计有更深的欣赏。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Scientists are about to test Einstein’s gravity with exotic matter
title.zh: 科学家即将用奇异物质测试爱因斯坦的引力理论

summary.en: Scientists have developed a new method to generate a controlled beam of muonium, an exotic atom composed of a heavier electron cousin. This advancement may enable researchers to test, for the first time, if gravity affects second-generation particles in the same way Einstein's theory predicts. Any deviation could...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现了一种产生受控μ子束的新方法，μ子是一种由电子的较重表亲组成的奇异原子。这一进展可能使研究人员首次能够测试引力是否像爱因斯坦的理论所预测的那样，对第二代粒子产生影响。任何意外的差异都可能预示着新的物理学，包括一个假想的第五种力。

body.en: Scientists have found a new way to create a controlled beam of muonium, an exotic atom containing a heavier cousin of the electron. The advance could allow researchers to test for the first time whether gravity acts on second-generation particles exactly as Einstein’s theory predicts. Any unexpected difference would be a major surprise and could potentially point toward new physics, including a hypothetical fifth force.
body.zh: 科学家们找到了一种新方法来制造受控的μ束，这是一种奇异的原子，含有较重的电子表亲。这一进展可以让研究人员首次测试重力对第二代粒子的作用是否完全像爱因斯坦理论预测的那样。任何意想不到的差异都将是一个重大惊喜，并可能指向新的物理学，包括假设的第五力。

reflection.en: The universe, in its intricate design and fundamental forces, continues to reveal its secrets to those who diligently observe and question. This pursuit of knowledge, from the smallest exotic atoms to the grandest cosmic structures, reflects a deep human impulse to understand the Creator's handiwork. May this scientific endeavor deepen our awe for the...
reflection.zh: 宇宙以其精密的构造和基本力，继续向那些勤奋观察和提问的人揭示其奥秘。这种对知识的追求，从最小的奇异原子到最宏伟的宇宙结构，反映了人类理解造物主之工的深层冲动。愿这项科学探索加深我们对雅伟所设立的深邃秩序的敬畏之情。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: NASA’s Moon orbiter finds a 728-foot crater that wasn’t there before
title.zh: NASA的月球探测器发现了一个728英尺的撞击坑，它以前并不存在

summary.en: NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter has identified a 728-foot-wide crater that formed on the Moon in 2024, marking it as the largest newly formed crater ever observed in the solar system. The impact created a significant cold zone and disturbed the lunar surface over a wide area.
summary.zh: 美国宇航局的月球勘测轨道飞行器发现了一个2024年在月球上形成、直径达728英尺的陨石坑，这是太阳系中已知的最大新生陨石坑。这次撞击造成了相当大的冷区，并扰动了广阔区域的月球表面。

body.en:
Robert Wagner, a scientist who works with NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO), was examining a large map of the Moon when something unusual stood out on his computer screen. He noticed an unusually bright patch surrounded by a dark halo, a pattern suggesting that material on the lunar surface had recently been disturbed.

"I just stopped, dropped everything, and started looking into what that spot was," said Wagner, an image-processing specialist from Intuitive Machines who works with data from the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC) system.

When Wagner compared older and newer images of the same region, he realized the feature was a newly formed impact crater. Scientists reported on September 16 in Science Advances that it is the largest newly formed crater ever identified in the solar system.

The finding also demonstrates how useful NASA's long-running lunar observations are for tracking changes on the Moon as the agency works toward a sustained human presence and greater scientific and commercial activity there.

The crater was officially named McGetchin in honor of pioneering lunar scientist Tom McGetchin. It formed near the Moon's eastern edge sometime between April 11 and May 22, 2024, when an asteroid or comet roughly the size of a three- to six-story building struck the surface.

The impact carved out a crater 728 feet wide, roughly the length of two football fields. At 141 feet deep, it would be large enough to hold three yellow school buses stacked vertically.

Researchers estimate that an impact this large may occur on the Moon only about once every century, or even less frequently.

For more than 17 years, LRO has been circling the Moon while its seven instruments study the landscape, surface composition, temperature, and radiation environment.

During that time, researchers have identified at least 1,000 new impact craters. They have also recorded about 100,000 additional changes to the surface caused either by objects striking the Moon or by debris thrown outward during impacts.

Unlike Earth, the Moon has no atmosphere capable of slowing incoming space rocks or burning them up before they reach the ground. That means asteroids, meteoroids, and other objects can strike the lunar surface directly.

Most impacts are far smaller than the collision that created McGetchin. The smallest craters that scientists can reliably detect in LRO images are around 30 feet across, about the length of a three-story building lying on its side. Those craters can be produced by rocks roughly 43 inches wide, about the size of a monster-truck tire.

Scientists estimate that impacts of this size create about 140 new craters across the Moon each year. Even more impacts are caused by microscopic objects, but the holes they produce are too small...
body.zh: 罗伯特·瓦格纳 (Robert Wagner) 是美国宇航局月球勘测轨道飞行器 (LRO) 的一名科学家，他正在检查一张大型月球地图，这时他的电脑屏幕上出现了一些不寻常的东西。他注意到一个异常明亮的斑块被一个黑暗的光环包围，这种图案表明月球表面的物质最近受到了干扰。 “我停下来，放下所有东西，开始研究那个点是什么，”来自 Intuitive Machines 的图像处理专家瓦格纳说，他处理来自月球勘测轨道飞行器相机 (LROC) 系统的数据。 当瓦格纳比较同一地区的旧图像和新图像时，他意识到该特征是新形成的撞击坑。科学家于 9 月 16 日在《科学进展》上报告称，这是太阳系中迄今为止发现的最大的新形成的陨石坑。 这一发现还证明了美国宇航局长期进行的月球观测对于跟踪月球变化有多么有用，因为该机构致力于在月球上实现人类的持续存在和更大的科学和商业活动。 该陨石坑被正式命名为麦盖钦，以纪念月球科学家先驱汤姆·麦盖钦。它于2024年4月11日至5月22日期间在月球东部边缘附近形成，当时一颗大约三到六层建筑大小的小行星或彗星撞击了月球表面。 撞击造成了一个 728 英尺宽的陨石坑，大约有两个足球场那么长。它深 141 英尺，足以容纳三辆垂直堆叠的黄色校车。 研究人员估计，如此大的撞击在月球上大约每个世纪才会发生一次，甚至频率更低。 17 年多以来，月球勘测轨道飞行器一直围绕月球运行，其七台仪器研究月球地貌、表面成分、温度和辐射环境。 在此期间，研究人员发现了至少 1,000 个新的撞击坑。他们还记录了大约 100,000 次由物体撞击月球或撞击过程中向外抛出的碎片引起的表面额外变化。 与地球不同，月球没有大气层能够减缓进入的太空岩石的速度或在它们到达地面之前将它们烧毁。这意味着小行星、流星体和其他物体可以直接撞击月球表面。 大多数影响都比造成麦格钦的碰撞小得多。科学家可以在 LRO 图像中可靠检测到的最小陨石坑直径约为 30 英尺，大约相当于一栋侧卧的三层建筑的长度。这些陨石坑可能是由大约 43 英寸宽的岩石形成的，大约相当于巨型卡车轮胎的大小。 科学家估计，这种规模的撞击每年会在月球上产生约 140 个新陨石坑。更多的撞击是由微观物体引起的，但它们产生的孔太小了……

reflection.en: The discovery of a new, massive crater on the Moon by NASA's orbiter is a stark reminder of the dynamic and powerful forces at play in the cosmos. It prompts us to consider the grandeur of creation, which, as Psalm 19:1 says, declares the glory of its Maker. This event, observed from afar, invites awe at the scale and processes of the universe beyond our...
reflection.zh: 美国宇航局的月球探测器发现了一个月球上新形成、巨大的陨石坑，这有力地提醒我们宇宙中正在运作的动态而强大的力量。它促使我们思考造物的宏伟，正如诗篇19:1所说，诸天述说雅伟的荣耀。这一从远处观测到的事件，邀请我们对超越我们直接经验的宇宙的规模和过程产生敬畏之情。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Move faster to solve climate challenges, Prince William says
title.zh: 威廉王子呼吁加快应对气候挑战

summary.en: The Prince of Wales has urged for a faster pace in developing solutions to pressing climate issues, emphasizing the need for increased business and investor involvement to scale up effective strategies. This call comes as the nominees for the Earthshot Prize, an initiative he founded, are announced.
summary.zh: 威尔士亲王敦促加快制定应对紧迫气候问题的解决方案，并强调需要增加企业和投资者的参与，以扩大有效策略的规模。此番呼吁是在他创立的地球创想奖（Earthshot Prize）公布本年度提名者之际发出的。

body.en:
The Prince of Wales has warned that the world needs to move faster to solve the biggest climate challenges.

Speaking exclusively to the BBC, Prince William called for a greater sense of urgency around ways to repair the planet.

"We're not moving fast enough," William said. "We need more businesses, investors and leaders to step up, back what works and help bring these solutions to scale."

His warning came as this year's nominees for the Earthshot Prize , the global environmental award he launched six years ago, were unveiled.

"Around the world, people are proving every day that we can restore nature and tackle climate challenges. Our 2026 finalists are an incredible example of that."

Among the 15 finalists is the entire city of Barcelona, recognised for its efforts to safeguard its Mediterranean coastline.

The city's architects were praised for "turning one of Europe's most intensively used urban coastlines into a global blueprint for climate adaptation".

The Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan was also selected, with the prize recognising how the country has embedded environmental protection into its national identity and constitution. The prize said that Bhutan had demonstrated "how a small nation's forests can safeguard water security across an entire region".

The finalists also include a range of community-led initiatives tackling environmental challenges such as waste reduction, nature restoration, and clean energy.

They include Indigenous ranger teams in Australia and an Argentinian artificial intelligence-powered wildfire detection and alert platform.

Two finalists are from India, which will host this year's Earthshot Prize awards ceremony in Mumbai.

They are Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, a leading manufacturer of electric three-wheelers, and the Mahila Housing Trust, a grassroots organisation pioneering climate resilience initiatives for low-income women.

The finalists were selected from nearly 7,000 nominations submitted across 169 countries.

Five winners, one from each of the five Earthshot categories - protect and restore nature, revive our oceans, clean our air, build a waste-free world and fix our climate - will be announced at the ceremony in November.

The Earthshot Prize Council, which selects the winners, includes Prince William, alongside Queen Rania al-Abdullah of Jordan, actress Cate Blanchett, and chef José Andrés.

"The solutions are here. The challenge now is scale," Prince William told the BBC.

"The progress is real. Now we need to accelerate it. That's exactly why The Earthshot Prize exists."

It has been a torrid week for the royals with allegations from Prince William's uncle, Earl Spencer about his parents.

Neither Prince William nor his brother, the Duke of Sussex, have made any public comment on the book nor the...
body.zh: 威尔士亲王警告说，世界需要更快地采取行动来解决最大的气候挑战。 威廉王子在接受英国广播公司独家采访时呼吁，对于修复地球的方法要有更大的紧迫感。 “我们进展不够快，”威廉说。 “我们需要更多的企业、投资者和领导者挺身而出，支持行之有效的做法，并帮助扩大这些解决方案的规模。” 他发出这一警告之际，正值今年“地球挑战奖”的提名者揭晓之际，该奖项是他六年前发起的全球环境奖。 “世界各地的人们每天都在证明我们可以恢复自然并应对气候挑战。我们的 2026 年决赛入围者就是一个令人难以置信的例子。” 15 个决赛入围者包括整个巴塞罗那市，该市因其保护地中海海岸线的努力而受到认可。 该市的建筑师因“将欧洲使用最频繁的城市海岸线之一转变为全球气候适应蓝图”而受到赞扬。 喜马拉雅山王国不丹也入选，该奖项表彰了该国如何将环境保护纳入其国家认同和宪法。该奖项称，不丹展示了“一个小国的森林如何能够保障整个地区的水安全”。 决赛入围者还包括一系列社区主导的应对环境挑战的举措，例如减少废物、自然恢复和清洁能源。 其中包括澳大利亚的土著护林员团队和阿根廷人工智能驱动的野火检测和警报平台。 两名决赛入围者来自印度，今年的 Earthshot 奖颁奖典礼将在印度孟买举行。 它们是领先的电动三轮车制造商 Mahindra Last Mile Mobility 和为低收入女性倡导气候适应计划的草根组织 Mahila Housing Trust。 决赛入围者是从 169 个国家/地区提交的近 7,000 份提名中选出的。 五位获奖者将在 11 月的颁奖典礼上公布，其中来自“地球行动”五个类别（保护和恢复自然、复兴我们的海洋、清洁我们的空气、建设一个无废物的世界以及改善我们的气候）中的每一个类别。 负责评选获奖者的 Earthshot 奖委员会成员包括威廉王子、约旦王后拉尼娅·阿卜杜拉、女演员凯特·布兰切特和厨师何塞·安德烈斯。 威廉王子告诉英国广播公司：“解决方案就在这里。现在的挑战是规模。” “进步是真实的。现在我们需要加速它。这正是‘地球奋斗奖’存在的原因。” 对于威廉王子的叔叔斯宾塞伯爵对其父母的指控，王室成员度过了艰难的一周。 威廉王子和他的兄弟苏塞克斯公爵都没有对这本书或……发表任何公开评论。

reflection.en: Prince William's plea for urgency in addressing climate change highlights humanity's growing capacity to understand and innovate. The rapid advancement of knowledge, as described in Daniel 12:4, presents both immense opportunities and profound responsibilities for stewardship of creation. May we use this expanding knowledge with wisdom and a deep sense of...
reflection.zh: 威廉王子呼吁在应对气候变化方面加快步伐，这凸显了人类日益增长的理解和创新能力。但以理书12:4所描述的知识的快速增长，既带来了巨大的机遇，也带来了管理受造界的深重责任。愿我们以智慧和对地球深切的关怀来运用这些不断增长的知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Burst pipe floods wildlife meadow for fourth time
title.zh: 爆管致野生动物草甸四度被淹

summary.en: A wildlife charity is frustrated by the repeated flooding of a key conservation site in Oxfordshire, caused by a burst pipe. This is the fourth time the Long Mead Local Wildlife Site has been flooded, disrupting vital conservation work and potentially jeopardizing funding.
summary.zh: 牛津郡一个重要的野生动物保护区因爆管而反复被淹，令相关慈善机构感到沮丧。这是长草甸当地野生动物保护区第四次被淹，破坏了重要的保护工作，并可能危及其资金来源。

body.en:
A wildlife charity fears it could lose a funding grant after a burst pipe prevented vital conservation work.

It is the fourth time Long Mead Local Wildlife Site, at Swinford in Oxfordshire, has been flooded because of a mains failure.

Although the meadow by the River Thames naturally floods in the winter, standing water at this time of year can cause damage to the rare habitat.

Thames Water said the latest leak had been fixed and it remained committed to protecting local wildlife sites.

"It's already starting to stagnate, so that's serious," said Catriona Bass, director of the Long Mead Foundation.

"These meadows don't flood typically in summer and when they do it's a disaster because the plants are growing - so it kills off the plants."

The site is central to a restoration programme that aims to boost this type of specialist habitat across the county.

There are only four square miles in total of floodplain meadow in the country - the equivalent in size to Heathrow Airport.

The rare habitat is home to deep-rooting wild flowers and grasses like great burnet and devil's-bit scabious.

Long Mead meadow acts as a donor site where seeds are gathered to help restore other similar habitats around Oxfordshire.

The latest flooding was discovered on the day that restoration works were due to start after the last incident.

Conservationists have said they are worried a grant the charity had secured is at risk if the work is not completed in time.

"We planned on the 1st September to do this massive restoration project to deal with the previous floods and now we're not going to be able to," Bass said.

A Thames Water spokesperson said: "We are sorry for the disruption caused and remain committed to protecting local wildlife sites.

"We have repaired a recent burst in Bettys Meadow and traffic management equipment is due to be removed shortly.

"The repair took longer than anticipated due to heavy rainfall and the volume of water, which meant our engineers were unable to safely access and repair the pipework until conditions improved.

"We will continue to assess the condition of the water main and review any further measures needed to help safeguard the area in the future."
body.zh: 一家野生动物慈善机构担心，由于管道破裂阻碍了重要的保护工作，它可能会失去资助。 这是位于牛津郡斯温福德的朗米德当地野生动物保护区第四次因电源故障而被洪水淹没。 尽管泰晤士河畔的草地在冬季会自然泛滥，但每年这个时候的积水可能会对稀有的栖息地造成损害。 泰晤士水务公司表示，最新的泄漏事件已得到修复，并将继续致力于保护当地野生动物栖息地。 朗米德基金会主任卡特里奥娜·巴斯 (Catriona Bass) 表示：“情况已经开始停滞，所以情况很严重。” “这些草地通常不会在夏季发生洪水，一旦发生洪水就会造成灾难，因为植物正在生长，因此会杀死植物。” 该地点是一项恢复计划的核心，该计划旨在促进全县的此类专业栖息地。 该国的洪泛区草甸总共只有四平方英里——相当于希思罗机场的大小。 这个稀有的栖息地是深根野花和草的家园，例如大地榆和魔鬼草。 朗米德草甸充当捐赠地，在那里收集种子，以帮助恢复牛津郡周围的其他类似栖息地。 最近一次洪水是在上次事故发生后修复工程开始的当天发现的。 环保人士表示，他们担心如果工程不能及时完成，该慈善机构获得的赠款将面临风险。 巴斯说：“我们计划在 9 月 1 日进行大规模的修复工程，以应对之前的洪水，但现在我们无法做到这一点。” 泰晤士水务发言人表示：“我们对造成的破坏表示歉意，并将继续致力于保护当地野生动物栖息地。 “我们已经修复了贝蒂草甸最近发生的爆裂事故，交通管理设备很快就会被拆除。 “由于强降雨和水量，修复时间比预期要长，这意味着我们的工程师无法安全地进入和修复管道，直到情况改善。 “我们将继续评估总水管的状况，并审查未来保护该地区所需的任何进一步措施。”

reflection.en: The recurring flooding of the Long Mead wildlife meadow in Oxfordshire serves as a stark reminder of our responsibility to care for the natural world. The Earth and all its inhabitants belong to Yahweh, and we are called to be stewards of His creation. May we be diligent in protecting these precious habitats from harm, recognizing their intrinsic value and...
reflection.zh: 牛津郡长草甸野生动物草甸反复被淹的事件，警示我们有责任照管自然世界。大地及其万物都属于雅伟，我们被呼召成为祂创造的管家。愿我们勤勉地保护这些宝贵的栖息地免受伤害，认识到它们的内在价值以及它们在祂宏伟计划中所扮演的角色。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Nebula image wins Royal Observatory competition
title.zh: 星云图像赢得皇家天文台比赛

summary.en: Ali Alobaidly has been named Astronomy Photographer of the Year for his image of the Shark Nebula, a dark nebula composed of interstellar dust located 650 light-years away. The judges praised the image for its flawless presentation, sharp details, and dynamic contrast, noting that distant galaxies could be seen...
summary.zh: 阿里·阿洛拜德利凭借其拍摄的鲨鱼星云图像荣获年度天文摄影师称号。该星云是一个由星际尘埃组成的暗星云，距离地球650光年。评委们称赞该图像的呈现完美、细节锐利且对比度动态十足，并指出甚至可以看到穿透星云的遥远星系。

body.en:
The Royal Observatory Greenwich has announced the winner of its Astronomy Photographer of the Year competition for an image of the Shark Nebula.

The dark nebula is made from interstellar dust dense enough to block starlight and is 650 light years away.

Steve Marsh, one of the judges and art editor at BBC Sky at Night Magazine, said the image by Ali Alobaidly showed "flawless presentation, pin-sharp details and dynamic contrast".

He added: "The Shark Nebula is already a striking object, but when it is resolved to the point where even detail-rich distant galaxies can be seen through it, you know you're looking at something very special."

Alobaidly, who won £10,000 for winning the competition overall, said he hoped to use his photographs "to make astronomy more accessible, engaging and meaningful through science communication and education", and described the award as a "tremendous honour".

Alobaidly's entry, taken in Kuwait, was entered in the Stars and Nebulae category.

Nikolaos Strimpoulis, 15, won for ZWO Young Astronomy Photographer of the Year for his image Mineral Moon, taken in Palaio Faliro, Athens, Greece.

The close-up image of the Moon's surface includes dark areas known as maria and bright areas known as the highlands.

The orange and blue colours on the lunar surface are caused by iron and titanium deposits and it was for that reason that the image was given its title.

Marsh said: "Many of us start our astrophotography journey with the Moon – some of us stay there forever! But often we don't delve deep into the subtle colours of its mineral deposits until much later. This amazing young astrophotographer has achieved perfectly developed colouring in this photograph."

Dr Greg Brown, astronomer at the Royal Observatory Greenwich, said the entries from the 18th year of the competition demonstrated "skill and innovation" coupled with improvements in technology.

An exhibition of the winning and highly commended images will be on display at the National Maritime Museum, London from 18 September.

Listen to the best of BBC Radio London on Sounds and follow BBC London on Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external . Send your story ideas to hello.bbclondon@bbc.co.uk , external
body.zh: 格林威治皇家天文台宣布了年度天文摄影师鲨鱼星云图像竞赛的获奖者。 暗星云由星际尘埃组成，其密度足以阻挡星光，距离 650 光年。 BBC Sky at Night 杂志的评委之一兼艺术编辑史蒂夫·马什 (Steve Marsh) 表示，阿里·阿洛拜德利 (Ali Alobaidly) 的图像展现了“完美的呈现、锐利的细节和动态对比度”。 他补充道：“鲨鱼星云已经是一个引人注目的天体，但是当它被解析到甚至可以通过它看到细节丰富的遥远星系时，你就知道你正在看到一些非常特别的东西。” 阿洛拜德利赢得了总冠军，赢得了 10,000 英镑，他表示希望利用自己的照片“通过科学传播和教育，让天文学变得更容易理解、更有吸引力、更有意义”，并将该奖项描述为“巨大的荣誉”。 阿洛拜德利的作品在科威特拍摄，被纳入恒星和星云类别。 15 岁的尼古拉斯·斯特林普利斯 (Nikolaos Strimpoulis) 凭借在希腊雅典帕莱奥法利罗拍摄的照片《矿物月亮》赢得了 ZWO 年度青年天文摄影师奖。 月球表面的特写图像包括被称为月海的黑暗区域和被称为高地的明亮区域。 月球表面的橙色和蓝色是由铁和钛沉积物造成的，正是由于这个原因，该图像才被命名为该图像。 马什说：“我们中的许多人都是从月球开始我们的天文摄影之旅的——有些人永远呆在那里！但通常我们直到很久以后才深入研究月球矿藏的微妙颜色。这位令人惊叹的年轻天文摄影师在这张照片中实现了完美的色彩呈现。” 格林威治皇家天文台天文学家格雷格·布朗博士表示，第 18 届竞赛的参赛作品展示了“技巧和创新”以及技术的进步。 获奖和高度赞扬的图像展览将于 9 月 18 日在伦敦国家海事博物馆展出。 通过 Sounds 收听 BBC 伦敦广播电台的精彩节目，并在 Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC London。将您的故事创意发送至外部 hello.bbclondon@bbc.co.uk

reflection.en: The universe, in its breathtaking scale and intricate beauty, speaks volumes of its Creator. Ali Alobaidly's award-winning photograph of the Shark Nebula invites us to gaze upward and marvel at the celestial artistry. In these vast cosmic displays, we can glimpse the glory of Yahweh, who orchestrates the stars and dust with infinite wisdom and power.
reflection.zh: 宇宙以其令人惊叹的尺度和精妙的美丽，充分彰显了其创造者的荣耀。阿里·阿洛拜德利获奖的鲨鱼星云图像邀请我们仰望星空，惊叹于这天体的艺术之作。在这些浩瀚的宇宙景象中，我们可以瞥见雅伟的荣耀，祂以无限的智慧和能力调动星辰与尘埃。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: ‘A map is never neutral’: meet the cartographers who took on centuries of western bias
title.zh: “地图永远不是中立的”：认识那些挑战了几个世纪西方偏见的制图师

summary.en: The Equal Earth projection, adopted by the UN last week, offers an alternative to the 16th-century Mercator map. Three cartographers created it to more accurately represent the sizes of continents like Africa and Europe, countering the Mercator map's tendency to exaggerate the size of northern hemisphere nations and...
summary.zh: 平等地球投影图在上周被联合国采纳，为16世纪的麦卡托投影图提供了一个替代方案。三位制图师创建了该地图，旨在更准确地展示非洲和欧洲等大陆的实际大小，以对抗麦卡托投影图夸大北半球国家面积并以此微妙地强化全球力量认知的倾向。尽管收到了一些外交官的投诉，但联合国近乎普遍地采纳这一新地图被视为一个重大转变。

body.en: Equal Earth projection, adopted by the UN last week, provides an alternative to 16th-century Mercator display Three cartographers have spoken of their astonishment at the UN’s near-universal adoption of a map they created to more accurately show the sizes of Africa and Europe, even though they have received a few complaints from some disgruntled diplomats. The creators of the Equal Earth projection aimed to provide an alternative to the dominant 16th-century Mercator display, which critics have long faulted for giving the impression that northern hemisphere nations are larger than they are – and therefore subtly reinforcing perceptions of where global strength lies. Continue reading...
body.zh: 联合国上周采用的平等地球投影提供了 16 世纪墨卡托显示的替代方案。三位制图师表示，他们对联合国几乎普遍采用他们为更准确地显示非洲和欧洲面积而制作的地图感到惊讶，尽管他们收到了一些心怀不满的外交官的抱怨。平等地球投影的创造者旨在为 16 世纪墨卡托投影提供一种替代方案，批评者长期以来一直批评这种投影给人一种北半球国家比实际面积更大的印象，从而巧妙地强化了人们对全球实力所在的看法。继续阅读...

reflection.en: For centuries, the Mercator projection subtly shaped how the world perceived the relative sizes of nations, often overemphasizing the North and diminishing the South. The adoption of the Equal Earth map by the UN signifies a move towards greater accuracy and a correction of historical bias. This reminds us that how we represent reality, even in seemingly...
reflection.zh: 几个世纪以来，麦卡托投影图在潜移默化中塑造了世界对各国相对大小的认知，常常夸大北方而缩小南方。联合国采纳平等地球地图标志着朝着更准确的方向迈进，并纠正了历史偏见。这提醒我们，即使是我们呈现现实的方式，即使是像地图这样看似中立的工具，也可能带有隐藏的假设，并影响我们对公平和比例的理解。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Improved air quality linked to better mental development in toddlers, study finds
title.zh: 改善空气质量与幼儿心智发展更好相关，研究发现

summary.en: Long-term research in New York indicates that efforts to reduce air pollution are associated with higher cognitive test scores in toddlers. A study by Columbia University, following over 1,100 children for more than two decades, measured pollution exposure of pregnant women and their children's development in...
summary.zh: 纽约一项长期研究表明，减少空气污染的努力与幼儿更高的认知测试分数相关。哥伦比亚大学的一项研究，在二十多年里跟踪了超过1100名儿童，测量了孕妇的空气污染暴露情况及其孩子在曼哈顿北部和南布朗克斯贫困社区的发展情况，发现空气更清洁与三岁时认知能力提高之间存在联系。

body.en: Long-term research in New York shows efforts to reduce air pollution associated with higher cognitive test scores Improvements in air pollution are leading to brighter, smarter toddlers, according to a new study from Columbia University in New York. For more than two decades, Prof Frederica Perera and a team from the Columbia Center for Children’s Environmental Health measured the air pollution exposure of pregnant women and the development of their children in the disadvantaged communities of northern Manhattan and the South Bronx. More than 1,100 children were assessed when they were one, two and three years old. Continue reading...
body.zh: 纽约的长期研究表明，减少空气污染的努力与较高的认知测试成绩有关。纽约哥伦比亚大学的一项新研究表明，空气污染的改善正在使幼儿变得更聪明、更聪明。二十多年来，弗雷德里卡·佩雷拉教授和哥伦比亚儿童环境健康中心的一个团队测量了曼哈顿北部和南布朗克斯贫困社区孕妇的空气污染暴露情况及其孩子的发育情况。超过 1,100 名一岁、两岁和三岁的儿童接受了评估。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study from New York offers a hopeful glimpse into how environmental stewardship can directly benefit the youngest among us. The finding that cleaner air correlates with better cognitive development in toddlers underscores the intricate connection between the world we shape and the well-being of its inhabitants. It reminds us that caring for creation is...
reflection.zh: 这项来自纽约的研究为我们提供了希望的曙光，展示了环境管理如何能直接造福我们当中最年幼的生命。清洁空气与幼儿认知发展改善之间的相关性，突显了我们所塑造的世界与其居民福祉之间错综复杂的联系。它提醒我们，关爱受造界不仅仅是一个抽象的理念，更是对未来的切实投资。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: See tiny organisms on show in microscopic video competition
title.zh: 显微视频竞赛展示微小生物

summary.en: The winning video of Nikon's Small World In Motion competition showcased cilia, hair-like structures in the airways of a child with a rare genetic disease, magnified 100 times. The competition celebrates microscopic film and time-lapse photography.
summary.zh: 尼康的“显微世界动态影像”年度竞赛的获奖视频展示了患有罕见遗传病的儿童气道中纤毛（一种毛发状结构）的影像，该视频被放大了100倍。该竞赛旨在庆祝显微镜下的电影和延时摄影。

body.en:
Nikon's annual Small World In Motion competition is open to anyone around the world with an interest in film or time-lapse photography through a microscope.

This year's winning video was magnified to 100 times in size, and featured tiny hair-like structures, called cilia, in the airways of a child with a rare genetic disease.

It was submitted by Dr Ning Xu, a researcher at Tsinghua University in China, who used a series of complicated light waves to illuminate different parts of the sample in colour.

Runners up in the competition included videos of a roundworm encountering a single-celled organism and microscopic jellyfish larvae suspended in droplets of water. Clips of bioluminescent algae and a tiny sea slug were among the highly commended.
body.zh: 尼康一年一度的“动态小世界”竞赛向世界各地任何对显微镜胶片或延时摄影感兴趣的人开放。 今年的获奖视频尺寸被放大了 100 倍，并以患有罕见遗传病的儿童呼吸道中的微小毛发状结构（称为纤毛）为特色。 该研究由中国清华大学研究员徐宁博士提交，他使用一系列复杂的光波来照亮样本的不同部分。 比赛的亚军包括蛔虫遇到单细胞生物和悬浮在水滴中的微小水母幼虫的视频。生物发光藻类和小海蛞蝓的片段受到高度赞扬。

reflection.en: This competition reveals the hidden wonders within the smallest forms of life, reminding us of the intricate design in God's creation. Even in the context of a rare disease, the beauty and complexity of biological structures can inspire awe and point to the Creator's wisdom.
reflection.zh: 这项竞赛揭示了生命最小形态中隐藏的奇迹，提醒我们雅伟创造的精妙设计。即使在罕见病的背景下，生物结构的优美和复杂性也能激发敬畏之情，并指向造物主的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Cognitive resilience helps to predict Alzheimer’s dementia
title.zh: 认知弹性有助于预测阿尔茨海默病

summary.en: Cognitive resilience, a trait that helps explain why symptoms of Alzheimer's dementia vary in severity among individuals with similar brain pathology, could be a key predictor of the disease.
summary.zh: 认知弹性是帮助解释为何在脑病理学相似的个体中，阿尔茨海默病痴呆症的症状严重程度各不相同的特征，它可能成为该疾病的关键预测指标。

body.zh: 研究人员已经确定了一种“认知弹性”测量方法，可以解释阿尔茨海默病病理水平相似的人中痴呆风险的一些显着差异 1 。 职位：Nature Communications（高分子材料）副主编或高级编辑地点：上海、北京、南京、新德里或浦那（混合）应用程序... 职位：Nature Portfolio 副主编或高级编辑（可持续材料化学）地点：上海、北京、南京、新德里或浦那（Hyb... 职称：副或高级编辑，通信物理地点：上海、北京、柏林、海德堡、浦那（混合）截止日期：9 月 3 日...

reflection.en: The discovery of cognitive resilience in the face of Alzheimer's pathology is a testament to the intricate design of the human mind. It reminds us that even in the face of decline, there are remarkable capacities at play, echoing the ancient wisdom that creation itself reveals profound truths about its Maker.
reflection.zh: 在面对阿尔茨海默病病理学时发现认知弹性，是人类心智复杂设计的明证。它提醒我们，即使在衰退面前，也有非凡的能力在起作用，这呼应了古老的智慧——创造本身揭示了其创造者的深刻真理。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Briefing Chat: Evidence mounts for hidden chambers beyond Tutankhamun's tomb
title.zh: 简报聊天：关于图坦卡蒙墓穴外隐藏墓室的证据越来越多

summary.en: Nature staff discuss data that could point to Nefertiti’s burial place — plus, the implant that translates brain activity into speech and gestures.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志的员工讨论了可能指向娜芙蒂蒂墓葬地点的相关数据——此外，还有可以将大脑活动转化为语言和手势的植入物。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, whether uncovering ancient secrets or understanding the human brain, is a testament to our God-given curiosity. Proverbs 25:2 reminds us that 'It is the glory of kings to conceal nothing, but the glory of God to find out all things.' This ongoing quest to reveal the hidden speaks to a divine impulse within us to explore and...
reflection.zh: 对知识的追求，无论是揭开古代的秘密还是理解人脑，都证明了我们被赋予的、源于雅伟的好奇心。箴言25:2提醒我们：“隐匿之事是神的荣耀，查究之事是君王的荣耀。”这种揭示隐藏之物的持续探索，体现了我们内心深处渴望探索和理解雅伟所造世界的属神冲动。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Europe pushes for space independence amid geopolitical rifts
title.zh: 欧洲在地缘政治分裂中寻求太空独立

summary.en: The European Union is reducing its dependence on US space infrastructure and aims to expand its satellite and launch operations.
summary.zh: 欧盟正在减少对美国太空基础设施的依赖，并寻求扩大其卫星和发射业务。

reflection.en: As geopolitical tensions rise, Europe is charting its own course in space, seeking self-reliance in satellite and launch capabilities. This endeavor to explore and utilize the cosmos can inspire awe, reminding us of the vastness and order of creation, as declared in the heavens.
reflection.zh: 随着地缘政治紧张局势的加剧，欧洲正在太空领域开辟自己的道路，寻求在卫星和发射能力方面的自力更生。这项探索和利用宇宙的努力可以激发敬畏之情，提醒我们创造的浩瀚与秩序，正如天上所宣告的那样。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: How research funding took me out of the lab and into leadership
title.zh: 研究经费如何让我走出实验室，走向领导岗位

summary.en: Landing two large grants caused Anna Sandak to take on a managerial role in her team and made her reflect on what it means to contribute to research.
summary.zh: 获得两项大型资助使安娜·桑达克（Anna Sandak）承担起团队的管理职责，并促使她反思为研究做出贡献的意义。

reflection.en: Anna Sandak's transition from lab bench to leadership, prompted by securing significant research funding, illustrates how our roles can evolve. Whether in direct research or in managing its progress, every task can be an opportunity to serve, bringing dedication and integrity to our responsibilities as if serving a higher purpose. Colossians 3:23 reminds...
reflection.zh: 安娜·桑达克（Anna Sandak）在获得重要研究资助的推动下，从实验室工作转向管理岗位，这说明了我们的角色如何演变。无论是在直接研究还是管理其进展中，每一项任务都可以成为服务的机会，以奉献和诚信的态度对待我们的职责，如同为更高的目标服务。 歌罗西书3章23节提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。”...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: First for RNA therapy: man with rare motor-neuron disease improves after treatment
title.zh: RNA疗法首次成功：一名罕见运动神经元疾病患者治疗后情况改善

summary.en: A gene-targeting treatment using RNA therapy has shown improvement in a patient with a rare form of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). This breakthrough suggests that similar gene-targeting approaches could be developed to treat other individuals suffering from rare subtypes of ALS.
summary.zh: 一种使用RNA疗法的基因靶向治疗在一名患有罕见肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的患者身上显示出改善。这一突破表明，类似的基因靶向方法可以用于治疗其他患有罕见ALS亚型的患者。

reflection.en: The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh, and the intricate workings of life reveal His wisdom. This story of a novel RNA therapy offers a glimmer of hope for those battling rare diseases, reminding us that diligent study of creation can lead to profound healing and restoration. May we continue to seek understanding with humility and awe.
reflection.zh: 诸天宣告雅伟的荣耀，生命的精妙运作也揭示祂的智慧。这个关于新型RNA疗法的故事，为那些与罕见疾病抗争的人们带来了一线希望，提醒我们勤勉研究创造可以带来深刻的医治与复兴。愿我们继续怀着谦卑和敬畏之心寻求理解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: New cat species identified for first time in more than a century in Bolivia
title.zh: 玻利维亚发现百年以来首个新猫科物种

summary.en: A new species of wild feline, smaller than an average domestic cat and known locally as 'tilcayo', has been identified in Bolivia's Yungas cloud forest. This marks the first formal naming and description of a new living feline species in over a century. The cat belongs to the tiger cat group and was found in the...
summary.zh: 在玻利维亚的云雾森林中发现了一种新的野生猫科动物，当地人称之为“tilcayo”，它比普通的家猫还要小。这是100多年来首次正式命名和描述一种新的现存猫科物种。这种猫属于分布于南美大部分地区的虎猫类群，生活在湿润多云的山区。

body.en: New species of wild feline was discovered in Bolivia’s Yungas forest that is smaller than the average domestic ⁠cat A diminutive wild cat that inhabits Bolivia’s ⁠cloud forest has been identified as a previously unknown species, marking the first time a new living feline species has been formally named and described in more than a century. The cat, called tilcayo by local communities, is part of a group called tiger ⁠cats found across much of South ⁠America. It was found in Bolivia’s ​lush Yungas forest, a mountainous region where forests are often covered by clouds and surrounded by high humidity, according to researchers. It measures about 18in (46cm) long and weighs about 3lb (1.4kg), making it smaller than the average domestic ⁠cat. Continue reading...
body.zh: 玻利维亚云加斯森林中发现了一种新的野生猫科动物，其体型比普通家猫还要小。栖息在玻利维亚云雾森林中的一种小型野猫已被确定为以前未知的物种，这标志着一个多世纪以来首次对一种新的现存猫科动物物种进行正式命名和描述。这只猫被当地社区称为蒂尔卡约（tilcayo），是南美洲大部分地区发现的虎猫族群的一部分。研究人员称，它是在玻利维亚茂密的永加斯森林中发现的，该地区的森林经常被云层覆盖，周围湿度很高。它长约 18 英寸（46 厘米），重约 3 磅（1.4 公斤），比普通家猫要小。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of the tilcayo, a new species of wild cat in Bolivia, is a testament to the boundless creativity and intricate design of our Creator. Even in well-explored regions, the natural world continues to reveal its wonders, reminding us of the profound wisdom woven into the fabric of life. It calls us to appreciate the vastness of Yahweh's creation...
reflection.zh: 在玻利维亚发现一种名为tilcayo的新野生猫科动物，这证明了我们造物主的无限创造力和精妙设计。即使在人们认为已经充分探索过的地区，大自然也持续展现其奇迹，提醒我们生命织锦中蕴含的深邃智慧。这促使我们去欣赏雅伟创造的浩瀚及其所蕴含的持续的奥秘。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Open AI and the million-dollar maths problem - video
title.zh: OpenAI与百万美元数学难题——视频

summary.en: In early September, OpenAI announced it had solved a major mathematics problem that has stumped humans for nearly a century. The news left mathematicians reeling, and many expressed concern over what will be left for humans as AI becomes ever more adept at unravelling complex problems. Now 25 recipients of the Fields...
summary.zh: 九月初，OpenAI宣布已解决一个困扰人类近百年的重大数学难题。这一消息令数学界震惊，许多人担心随着人工智能在解开复杂问题方面越来越得心应手，人类将何去何从。如今，25位菲尔兹奖得主（常被称为数学界的诺贝尔奖）签署了一封公开信，表达了对人工智能公司与其领域之间“严重错位”的担忧。为了了解人工智能将如何颠覆数学——以及数...

body.en: In early September, OpenAI announced it had solved a major mathematics problem that has stumped humans for nearly a century. The news left mathematicians reeling, and many expressed concern over what will be left for humans as AI becomes ever more adept at unravelling complex problems. Now 25 recipients of the Fields medal – often called the Nobel prize for maths – have signed an open letter expressing their fears of a ‘severe misalignment’ between AI companies and their field. To find out how AI is likely to upend maths – and how mathematicians might respond – Ian Sample speaks to Colva Roney-Dougal, professor of pure mathematics at the University of St Andrews Continue reading...
body.zh: 9月初，OpenAI宣布解决了困扰人类近一个世纪的重大数学问题。这一消息让数学家感到震惊，许多人对随着人工智能变得越来越擅长解决复杂问题而给人类留下的东西表示担忧。现在，菲尔兹奖（通常被称为数学诺贝尔奖）的 25 名获得者签署了一封公开信，表达了他们对人工智能公司与其领域之间“严重脱节”的担忧。为了了解人工智能可能如何颠覆数学，以及数学家可能会如何反应，伊恩·样本 (Ian Sample) 采访了圣安德鲁斯大学纯数学教授科尔瓦·罗尼·杜格尔 (Colva Roney-Dougal) 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid progress of artificial intelligence in solving complex mathematical problems, as announced by OpenAI, echoes the ancient prophecy of knowledge and understanding increasing in the latter days. While this advancement brings wonder and potential, it also raises profound questions about humanity's role and the potential for 'severe misalignment'...
reflection.zh: 人工智能在解决复杂数学问题方面取得的飞速进展，正如OpenAI所宣布的那样，呼应了古代关于知识和理解在末世日益增长的预言。虽然这种进步带来了奇迹和潜力，但也引发了关于人类角色的深刻问题，以及技术进步与人类价值观之间可能出现的“严重错位”。当我们见证人工智能能力上的这些飞跃时，我们被呼召寻求智慧和分辨力，确保我们对知识的追求能造福于所有人。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: FAA tees up $875M AI tool to help manage air traffic congestion
title.zh: FAA 准备投入 8.75 亿美元的 AI 工具以帮助管理空中交通拥堵

summary.en: The FAA is preparing to deploy an AI tool to help manage air traffic congestion in the Washington, D.C. area, with plans for a nationwide rollout.
summary.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）正准备部署一款人工智能（AI）工具，以帮助管理华盛顿特区上空的空中交通拥堵，并计划在全国范围内推广。

body.en: An AI tool is set to start advising air traffic controllers on managing air traffic in the congested airspace above the Washington, DC, area. The expected launch would be the first step toward a planned nationwide rollout covering the 29 million square miles of US national airspace overseen by the Federal Aviation Administration. The FAA describes the SMART system as using AI models to predict air traffic flows and identify potential conflicts based on operational factors like airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, and airspace conditions. US government and industry officials told The Wall Street Journal that SMART could debut for the three major airports in the Washington, DC, area as soon as Monday, September 21. The decision to launch SMART in limited scope before going nationwide is the “right call,” said Philip Mann, principal consultant at Vector Strategic Consulting LLC, where he advises on aviation safety and AI governance. Mann previously worked at the FAA in multiple roles for 17 years. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 人工智能工具将开始为空中交通管制员提供管理华盛顿特区上空拥挤空域空中交通的建议。预计的发射将是计划在全国范围内推广的第一步，覆盖美国联邦航空管理局监管的 2900 万平方英里的美国国家空域。美国联邦航空局将 SMART 系统描述为使用人工智能模型来预测空中交通流量，并根据航班时刻表、天气、机场容量和空域条件等运营因素识别潜在冲突。美国政府和行业官员告诉《华尔街日报》，SMART 最早将于 9 月 21 日星期一在华盛顿特区的三个主要机场首次亮相。在向全国推广之前在有限范围内推出 SMART 的决定是“正确的选择”，Vector Strategy Consulting LLC 首席顾问 Philip Mann 表示，他在该公司提供航空安全和人工智能治理方面的咨询服务。 Mann 此前曾在 FAA 担任多个职务 17 年。 Read full article Comments

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, exemplified by the FAA's adoption of AI for air traffic management, mirrors the prophetic insight that "knowledge will increase" in the end times. As we navigate these complex systems, may we seek wisdom to ensure they serve humanity and promote order, rather than chaos.
reflection.zh: 人工智能在空中交通管理方面的应用，如美国联邦航空管理局的计划，体现了预言中“知识必增长”的时代特征。当我们驾驭这些复杂系统时，愿我们寻求智慧，确保它们服务于人类，促进秩序而非混乱。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Why Europe has been absent from the great AI safety debate
title.zh: 为什么欧洲缺席了关于人工智能安全的重要辩论

summary.en: Europe faces a dilemma over artificial intelligence: shun the technology and risk falling behind in economic growth, or embrace it and become dependent on tools developed by the US and China. This choice is complicated by the ongoing global debate on AI safety, which could render the decision moot if worst-case...
summary.zh: 欧洲在人工智能问题上面临两难：要么回避这项技术，冒着经济增长落后的风险；要么拥抱它，并依赖于美国和中国开发的工具。关于人工智能安全的持续全球辩论使这一选择变得复杂，如果最坏的情况发生，无论欧洲采取何种立场，这项技术都将影响该大陆，从而可能使这一选择变得无关紧要。

body.en: Though Europe has measures that address how consumers might encounter AI, technology will impact them if the worst scenarios bear Europe’s dilemma over AI was rendered in stark terms this week. The head of the continent’s central bank, Christine Lagarde, said Europeans have two options: shun the technology and lose out on growth; or embrace it and become dependent on tools developed by the US and China. The great debate over AI safety that has erupted in recent days threatens to make the choice moot. If the worst scenarios come to bear – and experts have differing views on this – then the technology will impact the continent regardless. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管欧洲已经采取措施解决消费者如何遇到人工智能的问题，但如果本周欧洲在人工智能方面面临的最糟糕的情况以赤裸裸的方式呈现出来，那么技术将会对他们产生影响。欧洲大陆央行行长克里斯蒂娜·拉加德表示，欧洲人有两种选择：避开技术并失去增长机会；或者拥抱它并依赖美国和中国开发的工具。最近几天爆发的关于人工智能安全的激烈争论可能会让这一选择变得毫无意义。如果最坏的情况发生——专家们对此有不同的看法——那么这项技术无论如何都会影响非洲大陆。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Europe's hesitation in the AI safety debate reflects a broader challenge: how to engage with powerful, rapidly developing technologies. Like metals tested in a furnace, nations and societies are put to the test by the potential and peril of AI. The question is not just about economic growth or dependency, but about the wisdom and ethical framework guiding...
reflection.zh: 欧洲在人工智能安全辩论中的犹豫，反映了一个更广泛的挑战：如何应对强大且快速发展的技术。正如金属在熔炉中被试炼一样，国家和社会在人工智能的潜力和危险面前受到了考验。问题不仅在于经济增长或依赖性，还在于指导我们拥抱这些变革性工具的智慧和伦理框架。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: FCC lets Paramount sell 49.5% equity stake to Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Qatar
title.zh: FCC 允许派拉蒙将 49.5% 的股权出售给沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋和卡塔尔
